```ts
 *  symlinks whose `models-canary.mjs` is the stub. A recording `notify.sh` stands
 *  in the session registry, where `_models_push` finds the hook. */
function installTree(h: string, roster: unknown, canaryStub?: string): void {
  const ccd = join(h, 'ccrc', 'ccd');
  fs.mkdirSync(ccd, { recursive: true });
  for (const f of ['ccrc', 'ccrc-wrapper-shape', 'ccrc-doctor-checks', 'ccrc-models-probe']) {
    fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'ccd', f), join(ccd, f));
  }
  if (canaryStub === undefined) {
    fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'deploy'), join(h, 'ccrc', 'deploy'));
  } else {
    const deploy = join(h, 'ccrc', 'deploy');
    fs.mkdirSync(deploy, { recursive: true });
    for (const f of fs.readdirSync(join(REPO, 'deploy'))) {
      if (f !== 'models-canary.mjs') fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'deploy', f), join(deploy, f));
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(join(deploy, 'models-canary.mjs'), canaryStub, { mode: 0o755 });
  }
  fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'shared'), join(h, 'ccrc', 'shared'));
  fs.mkdirSync(join(h, '.ccrc'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(join(h, '.ccrc', 'accounts.json'), `${JSON.stringify(roster, null, 2)}\n`);
  fs.mkdirSync(join(h, '.cc-sessions'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(join(h, '.cc-sessions', 'notify.sh'),
    '#!/bin/sh\nprintf \'%s\\t%s\\n\' "$1" "$2" >> "$HOME/notify-calls"\n', { mode: 0o755 });
}

/** `ccrc-models.test.ts`'s `env()`: nothing ambient steers a case, and the
 *  manager tools are stand-ins that refuse. */
function env(h: string, extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
  const inherited: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = { ...process.env };
  for (const k of ['CCRC_CODEX_PROBE_S', 'CCRC_CODEX_READY_S', 'CCGPT_CONFIG', 'CCRC_MODELS_CANARY_S',
    'CCRC_MODELS_ADVANCE_BUDGET_S', 'CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S', 'CCRC_MODELS_NOW', 'CCRC_MODELS_PROBE_FIXTURE',
    'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'ALL_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy', 'all_proxy', 'NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY']) {
    delete inherited[k];
  }
  const e = ghContainedEnv(h, { ...inherited, HOME: h, ...extra }, { systemd: true });
  const poison = (name: string, says: string): void =>
    fs.writeFileSync(join(h, '.local', 'bin', name),
      `#!/bin/sh\n${MANAGER_STANDIN_MARK}\nprintf '%s\\n' "$*" >> "$HOME/${name}-poison"\necho "${says}" >&2\nexit 97\n`,
      { mode: 0o755 });
  poison('curl', 'ccrc tests must never reach a real server');
  poison('systemctl', "ccrc tests must never query this box's real systemd");
  poison('systemd-run', "ccrc tests must never start a real transient unit on this box's systemd");
  poison('launchctl', "ccrc tests must never query this box's real launchd");
  poison('pgrep', 'ccrc tests must never reach a real pgrep');
  poison('ccgpt', 'ccrc tests must never reach a real ccgpt');
  assertManagerStandIns(e, h);
  return e;
}

/** The lane library's tier question, redefined: it RETURNS (the real one never
 *  exits) the code in `<home>/fake/tier-<id>-<tier>`, else `<home>/fake/tier-<id>`,
 *  default 1 (not running), and logs each ask to `$HOME/lane-calls`. The stop
 *  and start are never reached on these paths (the first hour finds the tier
 *  down; every later hour finds its list unchanged); each logs, so a case that
 *  reached one shows it there. */
const FAKES = [
  '_codex_tier_ours() { printf \'ours %s %s\\n\' "$1" "$2" >> "$HOME/lane-calls"; local k="$HOME/fake/tier-$1-$2" rc=1; '
    + '[ -f "$k" ] || k="$HOME/fake/tier-$1"; [ -f "$k" ] && rc="$(cat "$k")"; return "$rc"; }',
  '_codex_stop_tier() { printf \'stop %s %s\\n\' "$1" "$2" >> "$HOME/lane-calls"; printf \'stopped\\n\'; }',
  '_codex_start_tier() { printf \'start %s %s\\n\' "$1" "$2" >> "$HOME/lane-calls"; return 0; }',
].join('\n');

/** A function called DIRECTLY, outside `cmd_models`, gets what `cmd_models`
 *  loads first: the shape contract, whose WRAPPER_ID_RE the lock and id
 *  helpers read. */
const SHAPE = '. "$CCRC_HERE/ccrc-wrapper-shape"';

interface Result { code: number; stdout: string; stderr: string }
const script = (call: string): string =>
  ['umask 022', `. "${join(home, 'ccrc', 'ccd', 'ccrc')}"`, FAKES, call].join('\n');
function sourced(call: string, extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): Result {
  const r = spawnSync(BASH, ['-c', script(call)], { env: env(home, extra), encoding: 'utf8', input: '' });
  return { code: r.status ?? -1, stdout: r.stdout ?? '', stderr: r.stderr ?? '' };
}
/** `sourced`, but asynchronous: the case acts while the refresh runs. Tracked,
 *  so `killLaneProcesses` ends it through its handle if the case fails. */
function sourcedAsync(call: string, extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): Promise<Result> {
  const child = spawn(BASH, ['-c', script(call)], { env: env(home, extra), stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  trackChild(home, child);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let stdout = '';
    let stderr = '';
    child.stdout!.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { stdout += d.toString(); });
    child.stderr!.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { stderr += d.toString(); });
    child.on('close', (code) => resolve({ code: code ?? -1, stdout, stderr }));
  });
}
const rawPath = (): string => join(home, 'raw-catalogue.json');
const refresh = (extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): Result =>
  sourced('cmd_models refresh lane-a', { CCRC_MODELS_PROBE_FIXTURE: rawPath(), ...extra });
const refreshAsync = (extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): Promise<Result> =>
  sourcedAsync('cmd_models refresh lane-a', { CCRC_MODELS_PROBE_FIXTURE: rawPath(), ...extra });

function oneObject(r: Result): Record<string, unknown> {
  const lines = r.stdout.split('\n');
  expect(lines[lines.length - 1], `stdout is not newline-terminated: ${JSON.stringify(r.stdout)}`).toBe('');
  expect(lines.length, `stdout carried ${lines.length - 1} lines, not one: ${r.stdout}${r.stderr}`).toBe(2);
  return JSON.parse(lines[0]!) as Record<string, unknown>;
}
const rowOf = (r: Result): Record<string, unknown> =>

};

      advance: [{ class: 'opus', from: 'model-5.6-gamma', to: 'model-6.1-gamma', outcome: 'abandoned', why: 'held' }] });
    expect(classes()['opus']).toBe('model-5.6-gamma');

  }, T);

  it('a manual refresh overlapping the timer: the second commit abandons, and one push goes out', async () => {
    // Review Focus (races and locks): both canary the same candidate; the

    expect(notifyCalls()).toHaveLength(1);

  it('a class emptied by hand stays empty through every later hour', async () => {

  it('a move cut short between the registry rename and materialise is settled by the next refresh, recorded and pushed once', async () => {

      // Review Focus (the crash gap, a hand set-class cut short; a class the

describe('_models_canary reads what the program printed (plan W2 Task 11)', () => {
  const quiet = (stub: string): Result => {
    home = mkTmp('ccrc-models-canary-shell-');
    installTree(home, stepRoster({ proxyPort: 45020, litellmPort: 45021, authDir: codexAuthDir('lane-a') }), stub);
    return sourced(`${SHAPE}\n_models_canary lane-a model-6.1-gamma low`);
  };

  it('no answer is failed, "canary gave no answer"', () => {
    const r = quiet('#!/usr/bin/env node\nprocess.exit(0);\n');
    expect(JSON.parse(r.stdout)).toEqual({ ok: true, op: 'canary', result: 'failed', status: null,
      reason: 'canary gave no answer' });
  });

  it('an expired bound (rc 124) is not-ready', () => {
    const r = quiet('#!/usr/bin/env node\nprocess.exit(124);\n');
    expect(JSON.parse(r.stdout)).toMatchObject({ ok: true, op: 'canary', result: 'not-ready' });
  });

  it("the canary's own bad-argv is unavailable, never failed", () => {
    const r = quiet('#!/usr/bin/env node\n'
      + "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'bad-argv', detail: 'x' }) + '\\n', () => process.exit(2));\n");
    expect(JSON.parse(r.stdout)).toEqual({ ok: true, op: 'canary', result: 'unavailable', status: null,
      reason: 'the canary refused its arguments (bad-argv)' });
  });
});

describe("the advance step's shape, pinned in source (plan W2 Task 11)", () => {
  it('takes the advance deadline once per run, before the lane loop', () => {
    const box = ccrcFunction('_models_box_sub');
    expect(box.match(/adv_deadline=/g)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(box.indexOf('adv_deadline=')).toBeLessThan(box.indexOf('while [ "$i" -lt "$n" ]'));
  });

  it("runs the advance step after the lane loop, never inside it (D-5213)", () => {
    const box = ccrcFunction('_models_box_sub');
    const loopEnd = box.indexOf('i=$((i + 1))');
    expect(loopEnd).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const calls = [...box.matchAll(/_models_advance_lane "/g)].map((m) => m.index!);
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(calls[0]).toBeGreaterThan(loopEnd);
  });

  it('never takes the tier lock, and sends each canary outside the lane-files lock', () => {
    const step = ccrcFunction('_models_advance_steps');
    expect(step).not.toContain('_codex_lock');
    expect(step).not.toMatch(/\b_models_lock\b/);
    const canaryLine = step.split('\n').find((l) => l.includes('_models_canary "$id"'));
    expect(canaryLine, 'the step sends no canary').toBeDefined();
    expect(canaryLine).not.toContain('_models_node_locked');
  });

  it("the canary's default deadline is one number in bash and node", () => {
    const bash = /CCRC_MODELS_CANARY_S:-(\d+)/.exec(ccrcFunction('_models_canary_secs'));
    const node = /^const CANARY_TIMEOUT_S = (\d+);$/m.exec(fs.readFileSync(join(REPO, 'deploy', 'models-canary.mjs'), 'utf8'));
    expect(bash![1]).toBe(node![1]);
  });

  it("a canary's reserve covers its outer bound, the kill grace, the commit's lock wait, its bounded node run and the push", () => {
    // 90 + 15 + 8 + 20 + 10 + 8 + 5: the commit's node runs under W1's
    // MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S (10 s) and that bound's kill grace at its 8 s ceiling,
    // and the push's curl is `-m 5` (`deploy/notify.sh`).
    home = mkTmp('ccrc-models-reserve-');
    installTree(home, stepRoster({ proxyPort: 45020, litellmPort: 45021, authDir: codexAuthDir('lane-a') }));
    expect(sourced('echo "$MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S"').stdout).toBe('10\n');
    expect(sourced('_models_canary_reserve_secs').stdout).toBe('156');
    expect(sourced('_models_canary_reserve_secs', { CCRC_MODELS_CANARY_S: '20', CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S: '1' }).stdout)
      .toBe('67');
  });

  it("the bash cap on a canary's reason is REASON_MAX, the advance file's one cap, which bash cannot import", () => {
    // REASON_MAX is defined once, in shared/model-advance.mjs. Bash
    // spells it as a literal, so the literal is held equal to it here.
    const m = /reason="\$\{reason:0:(\d+)\}"/.exec(ccrcFunction('_models_advance_steps'));
    expect(m, '_models_advance_steps no longer cuts the reason it passes to the commit').not.toBeNull();
    expect(Number(m![1])).toBe(REASON_MAX);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The nine functions**

In `ccd/ccrc`, insert immediately above the line `_models_box_sub() {   # <subcommand> [args…]`:

```bash
# ── The advance step (auto-advance spec §2.3; plan W2 Task 11) ───────────
# One lane's classes, moved to the newest model of their own family, canary
# first. The refresh arm below runs it as a SECOND PASS, after every lane's
# probe, materialise and LiteLLM render (D-5213), for
# each lane whose probe is `codex` and whose three steps all succeeded, inside
# `$( … )`, so nothing here can end the pass.
#
# THE ORDER, and which lock each step holds:
#   1. `advance-backfill`, under the lane-files lock (W1): creates the advance
#      file once, and settles a pending intent a crash left in one that exists
#      (D-5215). An automatic advance it finds LANDED
#      is reported as a `moved` event marked `recovered`, with the push a move
#      owes (D-5216). A hand set-class it finds landed
#      (W1's hand intent, `how: "hand"`) is recorded in the advance file as
#      the hand move it was, and is no event and no push: it was the
#      operator's own act, never an advance. Its refusal is not fatal here:
#      step 2 reports the file's state.
#   2. `advance-plan`, read-only, no lock: which classes have a candidate. An
#      ineligible lane, a held or blocked class, a refusal or an answer that is
#      not one object all end the lane with no further event.
#   3. READINESS, asked once, no lock (D22): `_codex_tier_ours <id> litellm` and
#      then `_codex_tier_ours <id> shim` each answer 0 (ours and running)
#      through the marker `_models_lane_verdict` reads — the shim's 0 is its
#      proof that the listener on the proxy port answers as THIS lane
#      (D-5210) — AND the check-only `litellm` op answers
#      `changed: false` (D-5196). Anything else waits
#      for the next hour, silently: 4 (starting), 1 (down), 2 (foreign) and 3
#      (cannot ask) alike (D-5197).
#   4. Per candidate, in CLASSES order: a canary only when it, its commit and
#      its push can all finish before the run's deadline
#      (`_models_canary_reserve_secs`, D-5214),
#      OUTSIDE every lock (D21). `not-ready` and `unavailable` end the lane
#      silently.
#   5. `advance-commit`, under the lane-files lock: it settles any pending
#      intent, then re-checks the hold, the pin and the candidate before it
#      moves anything. A refusal (a busy lock among them), or no answer at all
#      (W1 ends a commit's node at MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S, rc 124 with no body),
#      is an `abandoned` event whose `why` is the refusal word or `no-answer`,
#      and ends the lane (D-5209). Then one
#      push, when the answer says so.
# The advance step never takes `_codex_lock`, the tier lock.
#
# WITHOUT `flock` the step does nothing (D-5201): a commit
# that could not hold the lane-files lock could race a hand verb, and the hand
# verbs keep today's unserialised behaviour on such a box. PAST the deadline it
# does nothing either, not even the backfill: `CCRC_MODELS_ADVANCE_BUDGET_S=0`
# turns the step off.
_models_advance_lane() {   # <id> <deadline-secs> -> prints ONE JSON array of events; rc 0 always
  local -a evs=()
  _models_advance_steps "$1" "$2" || :
  printf '%s\n' "${evs[@]+"${evs[@]}"}" | jq -cs '.'
}

# The body of `_models_advance_lane`: every early end is a plain `return 0`, and
# every event is appended to the CALLER's `evs` (bash's dynamic scope, the way
# `_codex_tier_ours` reads CX_TIER_ASKER), which the caller prints once.
_models_advance_steps() {   # <id> <deadline-secs> -> appends to the caller's `evs`; rc 0 always
  local id="$1" deadline="$2" file bf plan cands n k cls pin to ceff can result reason body why msg r120 check said
  local tier reserve
  local CX_VERDICT_RC CX_VERDICT_MARKED CX_VERDICT_SAID
  local -a rarg=()
  [ "$SECONDS" -lt "$deadline" ] 2>/dev/null || return 0
  command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
  file="$(_models_roster_path)"
  # 1. The backfill, under the lane-files lock: creates the file once, and
  #    settles a pending intent every hour.
  bf="$(_models_node_locked "$id" advance-backfill --file "$file" --id "$id" 2>/dev/null)" || :
  _models_adv_settled "$bf"
  # 2. The plan, read-only.
  plan="$(_models_node advance-plan --file "$file" --id "$id" 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  cands="$(printf '%s' "$plan" | jq -c 'if .ok == true and .eligible == true and (.classes | type) == "array"
    then [.classes[] | select(.held == false and .blocked == null and (.candidate | type) == "string")]
    else [] end' 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  n="$(printf '%s' "$cands" | jq 'length' 2>/dev/null)" || n=0
  [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || return 0
  # 3. Readiness, asked once (D22): the LiteLLM tier, then the shim. The
  #    verdict is the marker each capture prints LAST, never the
  #    substitution's status: a fault inside the library leaves no marker, and
  #    reads 3, cannot ask.
  for tier in litellm shim; do
    said="$(
      _codex_tier_ours "$id" "$tier" 2>&1 >/dev/null; rc=$?
      printf '\nCX-VERDICT rc=%s' "$rc"
    )"
    _models_lane_verdict "$said"
    [ "$CX_VERDICT_RC" = 0 ] || return 0
  done
  check="$(_models_node litellm --file "$file" --id "$id" --template "$(_models_litellm_template)" \
             --out "$(_models_litellm_path "$id")" 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  [ "$(printf '%s' "$check" | jq -r '.changed' 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || return 0
  # 4 and 5. Per candidate, in CLASSES order.
  reserve="$(_models_canary_reserve_secs)"
  for (( k = 0; k < n; k++ )); do
    cls="$(printf '%s' "$cands" | jq -r ".[$k].class")"
    pin="$(printf '%s' "$cands" | jq -r ".[$k].pin // \"none\"")"
    to="$(printf '%s' "$cands" | jq -r ".[$k].candidate")"
    ceff="$(printf '%s' "$cands" | jq -r ".[$k].canaryEffort // \"none\"")"
    # The budget: no canary starts unless it, its commit and its push can all
    # end before the run's deadline.
    [ $(( SECONDS + reserve )) -le "$deadline" ] || break
    can="$(_models_canary "$id" "$to" "$ceff")"
    result="$(printf '%s' "$can" | jq -r '.result' 2>/dev/null)"
    case "$result" in
      passed|failed) ;;
      *) break ;;
    esac
    rarg=()
    if [ "$result" = failed ]; then
      # The canary's own reason, with any leading dash stripped (models-op
      # refuses a `--key` value that starts with `--`) and cut to 200
      # characters: REASON_MAX, the advance file's one cap on a history reason
      # (`shared/model-advance.mjs`), which bash cannot import.
      # `ccrc-models-advance.test.ts` holds this literal equal to it, and
      # `advance-commit` cuts the field again with the imported number.
      reason="$(printf '%s' "$can" | jq -r '.reason // ""' 2>/dev/null)"
      reason="${reason#"${reason%%[!-]*}"}"
      reason="${reason:0:200}"
      [ -n "$reason" ] || reason='the canary failed'
      rarg=(--reason "$reason")
    fi
    body="$(_models_node_locked "$id" advance-commit --file "$file" --id "$id" --class "$cls" \
              --from "$pin" --to "$to" --canary "$result" "${rarg[@]+"${rarg[@]}"}" 2>/dev/null)"
    if ! printf '%s' "$body" | jq -e '.ok == true and (.outcome | type) == "string"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      why="$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq -r '.error // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
      evs+=("$(jq -cn --arg c "$cls" --arg f "$pin" --arg t "$to" --arg w "${why:-no-answer}" \
        '{class: $c, from: (if $f == "none" then null else $f end), to: $t, outcome: "abandoned", why: $w}')")
      break
    fi
    _models_adv_settled "$body"
    evs+=("$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq -c '{class, from, to, outcome}
      + (if (.why | type) == "string" then {why} else {} end)
      + (if (.reason | type) == "string" then {reason} else {} end)
      + (if .restored == false then {restored: false} else {} end)')")
    [ "$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq -r '.push')" = true ] || continue
    r120="$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq -r '.reason // ""')"
    r120="${r120:0:120}"
    case "$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq -r '.outcome')" in
      moved) msg="$id: $cls $pin → $to" ;;
      failed)
        if [ "$result" = failed ]; then
          msg="$id: $cls stays on $pin: $to failed its canary ($r120)"
        else
          msg="$id: $cls stays on $pin: moving to $to failed ($r120)"
        fi ;;
      *) continue ;;
    esac
    _models_push "$msg"
  done
  return 0
}

# A pending intent a locked writer just settled as LANDED
# (D-5216): `<answer>` is `advance-backfill`'s or
# `advance-commit`'s, and its `recoveredMove` names a class whose move a crash
# cut short after the registry rename, with the intent's `how`. An AUTOMATIC
# advance's (`how: "advance"`) becomes a `moved` event marked `recovered`, and
# the one push a move owes. A HAND set-class's (`how: "hand"`, W1's intent,
# written before that verb's rename) is left out: the advance file already
# records it as the hand move it was, it was the operator's own act and owes
# no push, and reporting it here would call it an advance.
# Appends to the calling `_models_advance_steps`'s `evs` and reads its `id`
# (bash's dynamic scope).
_models_adv_settled() {   # <answer> -> rc 0
  local mv mcls mfrom mto msg
  mv="$(printf '%s' "$1" | jq -c 'select(type == "object") | .recoveredMove
    | select(type == "object" and .how == "advance")
    | select((.class | type) == "string" and (.to | type) == "string")' 2>/dev/null)" || return 0
  [ -n "$mv" ] || return 0
  mcls="$(printf '%s' "$mv" | jq -r '.class')"
  mfrom="$(printf '%s' "$mv" | jq -r '.from // "none"')"
  mto="$(printf '%s' "$mv" | jq -r '.to')"
  evs+=("$(jq -cn --arg c "$mcls" --arg f "$mfrom" --arg t "$mto" \
    '{class: $c, from: (if $f == "none" then null else $f end), to: $t, outcome: "moved", recovered: true}')")
  msg="$id: $mcls $mfrom → $mto"
  _models_push "$msg"
  return 0
}

# The canary's own deadline in seconds: `CCRC_MODELS_CANARY_S`, a whole number
# from 1 to 600, else 90 — `deploy/models-canary.mjs`'s `CANARY_TIMEOUT_S`, held
# equal by `ccrc-models-advance.test.ts`. LONGER than the shim's 60 s
# refused-connect wait (D-4933), so a restarting gateway answers the shim's own
# 502 (not ready) before this bound does.
_models_canary_secs() {
  local s="${CCRC_MODELS_CANARY_S:-90}"
  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*|????*) s=90 ;; esac
  s=$(( 10#$s ))
  { [ "$s" -ge 1 ] && [ "$s" -le 600 ]; } || s=90
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

# The lane-files lock's wait in seconds: `CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S`, a whole number
# from 1 to 300, else 20. `_models_lock` waits this long, and the advance step
# reserves it for each commit; one reading for both (plan W2 Task 11).
_models_lock_secs() {
  local s="${CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S:-20}"
  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*|????*) s=20 ;; esac
  s=$(( 10#$s ))
  { [ "$s" -ge 1 ] && [ "$s" -le 300 ]; } || s=20
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

# What one canary may cost the run, in seconds, before it is sent
# (D-5214): the canary's own deadline, plus 15 for
# `_models_canary`'s outer bound, plus 8 for `_plat_timeout`'s kill grace at
# its ceiling, plus the commit's wait for the lane-files lock, plus the
# commit's node run at its worst — W1's MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S (10) and that
# bound's own kill grace at its 8 s ceiling — plus 5 for the push's
# `curl -m 5` (`deploy/notify.sh`). With the defaults,
# 90 + 15 + 8 + 20 + 10 + 8 + 5 = 156.
_models_canary_reserve_secs() {
  printf '%s' "$(( $(_models_canary_secs) + 15 + 8 + $(_models_lock_secs) + MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S + 8 + 5 ))"
}

# The advance step's time budget for one refresh run, in seconds:
# `CCRC_MODELS_ADVANCE_BUDGET_S`, a whole number from 0 to 3600, else 250 —
# inside `deploy/systemd/ccrc-models.service`'s `TimeoutStartSec=300`. 0 turns
# the step off.
_models_advance_budget_secs() {
  local s="${CCRC_MODELS_ADVANCE_BUDGET_S:-250}"
  case "$s" in ''|*[!0-9]*|?????*) s=250 ;; esac
  s=$(( 10#$s ))
  [ "$s" -le 3600 ] || s=250
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

# One canary for one candidate (auto-advance spec §2.3 step 3): runs
# `deploy/models-canary.mjs`, which reads the lane's key IN ITS OWN PROCESS, so
# neither this argv nor this environment ever carries it. Bounded by
# `_plat_timeout` at the canary's own deadline plus 15 s. Prints ONE JSON
# object, always: the program's own answer when it printed one; `not-ready`
# when the bound expired (rc 124); `unavailable` when the program refused its
# own arguments (a value it cannot carry: a lane state, never a fact about the
# model, D-5218); `failed`, "canary gave no
# answer", for anything else (plan §3.6's last row).
_models_canary() {   # <id> <model> <effort|none> -> prints one JSON object; rc 0
  local s body rc=0
  s="$(_models_canary_secs)"
  body="$(_plat_timeout "$(( s + 15 ))" node "$CCRC_HERE/../deploy/models-canary.mjs" \
            --id "$1" --model "$2" --effort "$3" --timeout-s "$s" 2>/dev/null)" || rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ]; then
    jq -cn --arg r "the canary did not end within $(( s + 15 ))s" \
      '{ok: true, op: "canary", result: "not-ready", status: null, reason: $r}'
    return 0
  fi
  if printf '%s' "$body" | jq -e 'type == "object" and .ok == false and .error == "bad-argv"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    jq -cn '{ok: true, op: "canary", result: "unavailable", status: null, reason: "the canary refused its arguments (bad-argv)"}'
    return 0
  fi
  if printf '%s' "$body" | jq -e 'type == "object" and (.result | type) == "string"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '%s\n' "$body"
    return 0
  fi
  jq -cn '{ok: true, op: "canary", result: "failed", status: null, reason: "canary gave no answer"}'
  return 0
}

# One push for a class that moved or was held back (auto-advance spec §2.3
# steps 5 and 6), through the box's own notify hook — `$_SVC_REG/notify.sh`,
# the path `_inst_files` installs it at, spelled through `$_SVC_REG` and never
# a second `$HOME/.cc-sessions` (the rule beside `ACCT_LIVE_MEASURED`) — with
# its `--push` flag, so the server sends it to the phone as well as the banner
# (`/api/notify`, which pushes only a line `modelsPushOf` reads). Best-effort by
# the hook's own contract: its output is dropped and its status never ends the
# refresh.
_models_push() {   # <message> -> rc 0
  local hook="$_SVC_REG/notify.sh"
  [ -x "$hook" ] || return 0
  "$hook" --push "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
  return 0
}
```

```bash
      # THE ADVANCE STEP (auto-advance spec §2.3; plan W2 Task 11), a SECOND
      # pass, once every lane's probe, materialise and LiteLLM render is done
      # (D-5213): a canary can never delay another
      # lane's render past the unit's TimeoutStartSec, so a late SIGTERM can
      # only cut an advance short, whose crash gap `pending` covers, and never

            '{id: $id, ok: false, reason: ([$adv[] | select(.restored == false) | .reason][0]
              // "an advance could not restore the previous registry"), advance: $adv}')"
          failed=1
        else

        fi
      done
```

```ts
// 12): `deploy/notify.sh --push`, `POST /api/notify`'s `push: true`, and the

import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, symlinkSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import type { FastifyInstance } from 'fastify';
import { buildServer, type Deps } from '../src/server.js';
import { Bus } from '../src/bus.js';
import { loadConfig } from '../src/config.js';
import type { PushPayload, PushService } from '../src/push.js';
import { MODELS_PUSH_MAX, modelsPushOf } from '../../shared/models.js';

import { stepRoster } from './fixtures/advanceCases.js';

const REPO = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..');
const NOTIFY_SH = path.join(REPO, 'deploy', 'notify.sh');
const BASH = spawnSync('bash', ['-c', 'command -v bash'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).stdout.trim();
const realPath = (name: string): string => {
  const p = spawnSync('bash', ['-c', `command -v ${name}`], { encoding: 'utf8' }).stdout.trim();
  if (!p) throw new Error(`this box has no ${name} — the fixture needs it`);
  return p;
};
const MOVED = 'lane-a: opus model-5.6-gamma → model-6.1-gamma';
const MOVED_B = 'lane-b: opus model-5.6-gamma → model-6.1-gamma';
const CANARY_FAILED = 'lane-a: haiku stays on model-5.6-alpha: model-6-alpha failed its canary (http 500: upstream error)';
const REFUSED = 'ccrc-server: /api/notify: push:true on a notice that is not a model-class line of a codex-kind lane';

/** Runs the real `deploy/notify.sh` with `args`; answers the argv its `curl` saw. */
function runNotify(args: string[]): string[] {
  const home = mkTmp('ccrc-notify-push-');
  const bin = path.join(home, 'stub-bin');
  mkdirSync(bin, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path.join(bin, 'curl'),
    '#!/bin/sh\nfor a in "$@"; do printf \'%s\\n\' "$a"; done > "$HOME/curl-argv"\ncat > /dev/null\nexit 0\n',
    { mode: 0o755 });
  for (const n of ['jq', 'grep', 'tail', 'cut', 'tr', 'sed', 'head', 'cat']) symlinkSync(realPath(n), path.join(bin, n));
  mkdirSync(path.join(home, '.cc-secrets'), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path.join(home, '.cc-secrets', 'ccrc-mail.token'), `${'y'.repeat(64)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
  const r = spawnSync(BASH, [NOTIFY_SH, ...args],
    { env: { HOME: home, PATH: bin, CCRC_ADDR: 'http://127.0.0.1:9' }, encoding: 'utf8', input: '' });
  expect(r.status, r.stderr).toBe(0);
  const p = path.join(home, 'curl-argv');
  return existsSync(p) ? readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter((l) => l !== '') : [];
}
const bodyArg = (argv: string[]): string => argv[argv.indexOf('-d') + 1]!;
```

Insert immediately after Task 7's `export const MODELS_RESERVED_IDS = Object.freeze(['refresh', 'litellm']);`:

```js

/** The longest models notice `/api/notify` sends to the phone (auto-advance
 *  plan W2 Task 12): a lane id, a class, two model ids and a reason of at most
 *  120 characters fit inside it with room to spare. */
export const MODELS_PUSH_MAX = 300;

/** The ONE reader of the advance step's push lines (plan §3.8; `ccd/ccrc`'s
 *  `_models_advance_steps` and `_models_adv_settled` write them):
 *  `{lane, cls, kind}` for a message of exactly one of the three shapes
 *    `<lane>: <class> <from|none> → <to>`                                        kind `moved`
 *    `<lane>: <class> stays on <from|none>: <to> failed its canary (<reason>)`   kind `canary-failed`
 *    `<lane>: <class> stays on <from|none>: moving to <to> failed (<reason>)`    kind `move-failed`
 *  and null for anything else — a `cc swap:` notice, a second line, and any
 *  message over MODELS_PUSH_MAX included. The lane is MODELS_LANE_ID_RE's, the
 *  class one of CLASSES, each model id MODEL_ID_RE's (or `none`), and the
 *  reason printable ASCII of at most 120 characters: built from those three,
 *  never spelled a second time. `/api/notify` sends a phone push only for a
 *  line this reads (D-5211). */
export function modelsPushOf(message) {
  if (typeof message !== 'string' || message.length > MODELS_PUSH_MAX) return null;
  const inner = (re) => re.source.replace(/^\^/, '').replace(/\$$/, '');
  const lane = inner(MODELS_LANE_ID_RE);
  const id = inner(MODEL_ID_RE);
  const head = `^(${lane}): (${CLASSES.join('|')}) `;
  const shapes = [
    ['moved', new RegExp(`${head}(?:${id}) → (?:${id})$`)],
    ['canary-failed', new RegExp(`${head}stays on (?:${id}): (?:${id}) failed its canary \\([\\x20-\\x7e]{0,120}\\)$`)],
    ['move-failed', new RegExp(`${head}stays on (?:${id}): moving to (?:${id}) failed \\([\\x20-\\x7e]{0,120}\\)$`)],
  ];
  for (const [kind, re] of shapes) {
    const m = re.exec(message);
    if (m !== null) return { lane: m[1], cls: m[2], kind };
  }
  return null;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: The README's paragraph**

Insert, immediately above the heading line `### A ChatGPT/Codex lane: \`exec.kind: "codex"\` and \`ccrc codex\``
(after everything Stage 0 and W1 added to the section), a blank line and:

```markdown
**Classes follow new releases (Codex lanes).** The hourly `ccrc models refresh` moves each class of a Codex lane
(`exec.kind: "codex"`, probe `codex`) to the newest model of its own family: the last part of an id shaped
`<vendor>-<version>-<family>`, versions compared part by part as integers. It never moves a class backwards, except
when the class's own model has left a fresh catalogue. It runs after every lane has been probed and re-rendered, so
it never delays another lane's refresh. Before it moves a class it sends one "reply OK" request for the new model
through the lane's own proxy, and only after the proxy has answered as that lane; the request is authenticated with
the lane's key, read in-process and never put in an argv, and only a 200 with text moves the class. Then the lane's
files are re-materialised, the previous model is kept, and one push says so (`<id>: <class> <old> → <new>`; the
server sends a phone push only for a line of this kind, one notification per lane and class). The class keeps its
effort level when the new model offers it, and otherwise takes the highest level below it. A held class never moves
(`ccrc models <id> hold <class>`), `revert <class>` puts the previous model back and holds it, and a class you
emptied by hand stays empty. A model that has just appeared moves its class about an hour later, not in the same run:
its arrival re-renders the lane's LiteLLM list and restarts the tier, and the step waits silently while the lane's
LiteLLM tier or its shim is down, starting or not provably this lane's, while its list is stale, and while the shim
is still waiting out a restarting gateway. A canary that is refused (any other error, or an answer with no text)
keeps the class where it is, records the failure in `~/.ccrc/models/<id>.advance.json`, and sends one push, not one
an hour; the refresh unit stays green, and the next hour retries. A move that a stopped refresh cut short is
recorded, and pushed, by the next hour; a `set-class` stopped after it wrote the registry is recorded as the hand
change it was, by the lane's next models change or the next hour, and sends no push. The step does nothing on a
stale catalogue, on a lane that is not codex-kind, on a box without `flock`, or with
`CCRC_MODELS_ADVANCE_BUDGET_S=0`. A running session may keep the old model until it is relaunched, and
`ccrc doctor`'s `model-sessions-behind` check names one still on it a day after the move.
```

### W2 deviations beyond the skeleton

The skeleton's seventeen deviations stand as written (ruling RB1). This wave adds twelve more, each by its slug until
the allocator issues a number; each is stated in the task where it first appears.

| Slug | Where | Deviation, and why |
|---|---|---|
| D-5207 | Task 9 | A moved registry that `parseRegistry` or `modelEnvBlock` refuses is recorded as a failed advance (`canary: passed`, `restored: true`) rather than answered as a refusal, so doctor's held-back check names it instead of the hour failing silently |
| D-5208 | Tasks 9, 11 | `advance-commit`'s answer and the refresh event carry `restored` on a failed move after a passed canary; `restored: false` makes the row `ok: false`. Skeleton §3.3 and §3.7 name no such field, and without it a lane whose files no longer match its registry would read `ok: true` |
| D-5209 | Task 11 | A commit that never ran its re-check (`lock-busy`, `lock-unwritable`, `install-incomplete`, a node refusal, or no answer) is an `abandoned` event whose `why` is that word; §3.7 lists `why` only for the six re-check reasons. A persistent `lock-unwritable` is not silent: it is on every hourly row and refuses every hand verb on that lane (W1's `_models_answer_locked`), and W3's `model-advance-blocked` reports such a lane with cause `lock-unwritable`, measured read-only (ruling RC7). `no-answer` also covers a commit whose node W1's 10 s `MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S` ended |
| D-5210 | Tasks 10, 11 | Readiness also requires `_codex_tier_ours <id> shim` to answer 0, and the canary asks `GET /ccgpt/lane` with no key and sends the keyed request only when the listener answers as this lane, else `unavailable`. Skeleton §3.6 and §3.7 ask only the LiteLLM tier, which would hand the lane key to whatever listens on the shim's port (`ccd/ccgpt-proxy.py`: "a port is only a number") |
| D-5211 | Task 12 | `/api/notify` honours `push: true` only for a line `modelsPushOf` reads (L0, `shared/models.mjs`, at most 300 characters) whose lane is a roster row of `exec.kind: "codex"`; anything else gets the banner and a warning. A box token proves only "a process on the fleet box". Residual, accepted for this plan (ruling RC6) and stated in the code: a box-token holder can still send a well-shaped models line (attribution, not authentication), and a models push gets no feed record and no per-(lane, class) rate cap |
| D-5212 | Task 12 | The push tag is `models-advance:<lane>:<class>`, not §3.8's constant `models-advance`: a phone replaces a notification of the same tag (`pwa/public/push-sw.js`), so one tag would let a second move or failure in a run erase the first |
| D-5213 | Task 11 | The advance step runs as a second pass after every lane's probe, materialise and LiteLLM render, from the deadline taken once at the arm's start, so a late SIGTERM can only cut an advance short (which `pending` covers) and never a LiteLLM stop and start. Skeleton §3.7 ran it inside each lane's iteration |
| D-5214 | Task 11 | A canary is sent only when `SECONDS` plus its deadline + 15 (outer bound) + 8 (kill grace ceiling) + the lock wait + the commit's bounded node run (W1's `MODELS_NODE_BOUND_S`, 10, plus its kill grace ceiling, 8) + 5 (the push's `curl -m 5`) is within the deadline: 156 s by default, replacing §3.7's `+ 20`, which let the last commit and push run past the budget. `_models_lock`'s wait clamp moves into `_models_lock_secs`, read by both |
| D-5215 | Task 9 | `advance-backfill`, the hourly step's first locked writer, also settles a pending intent in a file that exists (W1's op only created). Without it, after a crash gap the moved class has no candidate, no commit runs, and the move never gets a history entry or a `previous`, so Revert cannot undo it |
| D-5216 | Tasks 9, 11 | `advance-backfill`'s and `advance-commit`'s answers carry `recoveredMove: {class, from, to, how}` when a settled intent had landed. An automatic advance's (`how: 'advance'`) is reported by the step as a `moved` event marked `recovered`, with that move's one push (§2.3 step 5). A hand set-class's (`how: 'hand'`, W1's intent under D-5188) is reported as hand, never as an advance (ruling RC3): no event and no push, and the commit's `recovered` stays false, matching the history entry, which carries no `recovered` mark |
| D-5217 | Task 9 | When the previous registry cannot be written back after a failed materialise, the failure is recorded and the intent KEPT (§3.3 step 9 clears it): the registry does pin the new model, so the next locked writer records the move as landed once the next refresh has re-materialised the lane |
| D-5218 | Task 11 | `_models_canary` reads the canary's own `bad-argv` as `unavailable` (silent), not as §3.6's "no answer → failed", so a value the canary cannot carry never records a failed advance or pushes about a model that is fine |

## Wave W3: doctor

### Wave contract

- **What it delivers.** One box-wide, read-only answer about every lane that has a model registry,
  `deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health` (Task 14); the pure rule that decides whether one session is behind a move,
  beside the family rule (`sessionBehind`, `isoSeconds` and `BEHIND_AFTER_MS` in `shared/model-advance.mjs`); the

**Measured at `a3cebde1b`, the facts §3.9 assumes** (read-only, in the base checkout):
- `$REG/<sid>.wrapper` holds the lane id a session runs on, written by ccd with `printf '%s'` and no newline
  (`_dr_cx_sessions`, `ccd/ccrc-doctor-checks:7296`); `$REG` is `~/.cc-sessions`, which `ccd/ccrc` spells once as
  `_SVC_REG` (`ccd/ccrc:96`).
- `$REG/<sid>.turn.json` is one JSON line from `ccd/session-hook.sh` (`TURN_MARK_PROGRAM`): `v: 1`, `sessionId` (the
  Claude Code session id), and `turnAt`, an epoch in MILLISECONDS from `_hook_epoch_ms` (`ccd/session-hook.sh:41-49`),
  set when a main-thread turn begins and `null` after a `/clear`. The server reads it with a 4096-byte cap
  (`TURN_MARK_MAX_BYTES`, `server/src/turnmark.ts`).
- The usage sidecar is `~/.cc-sessions/usage/<ccd id>.json` (`usageSidecarPath`, `server/src/usage.ts`), written by
  `ccd/statusline-command.sh` with `ts` in whole SECONDS (`date +%s`), `uuid` (the Claude Code session id), `model`
  (`.model.id`) and `agent` (null for the main loop). A subagent's render goes to `usage/<ccd id>.agents/<name>.json`.
- `_svc_is_active <unit>` answers one word, with `''` for a manager that did not answer (`ccd/ccrc:996`).
  `_dr_join` joins findings with `"; "` (`ccd/ccrc-doctor-checks:235-239`). `_plat_timeout <secs> <cmd> [args…]`
  runs a PROGRAM, never a shell function, and answers 124 on expiry (`ccd/ccrc:554`). That is why the skeleton's
  `_plat_timeout 20 _models_node advance-health …` is spelled here as `node "$CCRC_HERE/../deploy/models-op.mjs"`,
  W1's `_models_node_locked` spelling, and bounded by the doctor's own knob (D-5224,
  Task 15).
- The table line is `ccd/ccrc-doctor-checks:214`,
  `  models codex docs history docs-sw   # five entries on one line: every line below is cited by number elsewhere`;
  `_check_docs-sw` is the last function in the file.
- ccd has no `restart` verb. Its dispatch has `stop)` and `start)` arms (`ccd/ccd:39734` and `:39738`, the `case` at
  its foot), and `ccd start <id>`'s one-argument form re-launches an existing session with `--resume` (its header);
  it needs `$REG/<id>.uuid`, which `stop` keeps. `cmd_stop` ends in `tmux kill-session`, so a stop ends any turn in
  flight. A respawn carries `--model <class>` only when the session's routing record holds a class other than
  `default` (`[[ -n "$rclass" && "$rclass" != default ]] && routeflags="--model $rclass"`, `ccd/ccd:22760`), and spec
  §2.5 item 5 records that a session resumed without `--model` may come back on its old model. The skeleton's
  remedy `'ccd restart <id>'` names a verb that does not exist (D-5223, Task 15).
- The PWA's "Restart session" (`pwa/src/fleet/SessionActionsSheet.tsx`) runs `ccd start <id>`, which ADOPTS a pane
  that is still running ("nothing is restarted"), so it relaunches nothing on a live session; the remedy names the
  shell pair alone.

Line anchors below are at `a3cebde1b`. Stage 0, W1 and W2 move them, so every edit quotes the text to find. Every test
command runs cd'd into `server/`, in the foreground, with a timeout of at least 600000 ms, one file per command; never
a bare `npx vitest`. Every count in a mutation row is a prediction: run each row on the shipped file, restore it,
prove the restore with `git diff --exit-code -- <file>`, and record the row as measured.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: W1's `readAdvance`, `reconcilePending`, `heldBackOf`, `chooseCandidate`, `familyOf`, `now()`, `isObj` and

  `readWindowsFile(id)`; the base's `readCatalogue(id)`, `readRegistry(id, catalogue)`, `canCarryRegistry(account)`,
  `readRegular(p)`, its `isObj`, `refuse`, `out`. Test side: W1's `advPath`, `reg`, `ADVANCE_EXAMPLE`; W2's `STEP_CATALOGUE`,

- Produces, in `shared/model-advance.mjs` (declared in the `.d.mts`):
  - `BLOCKED_CAUSES` gains a last word, `'lock-unwritable'`.
  - `BEHIND_AFTER_MS: 86400000`, the one-day threshold, defined once (ruling RC8: it stands).
  - `isoSeconds(ms: number): string | null`: an epoch in ms as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`, or null.
  - `sessionBehind(a: { advance: Advance; registry: Registry; nowMs: number; turn: unknown; usage: unknown }):
    SessionBehind | null`, with `SessionBehind = { class: ModelClass; from: string; to: string | null; movedAt: string;
    turnAt: string; renderAt: string }`.
- Produces, the op (`deploy/models-op.mjs`, `writes: false`):
  - `node deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health --file <roster> --reg <session registry dir> --lock-template <path>`, all
    three required. `--reg` must be absolute; `--lock-template` must be absolute and hold `{id}` exactly once. Either
    refused is `bad-argv` at exit 2, checked after the roster read (`main` reads the roster before it dispatches any
    op) and before any lane file or session file is read (D-5219).
  - Answer, exit 0: `{ok: true, op: 'advance-health', now, sessions: 'read' | 'absent' | 'unreadable',
    sessionsUnmeasured: [{session, why: 'wrapper-unreadable'}], lanes: [{id, heldBack: [{class, from, to, reason,
    tries, since, canary}], heldBehind: [{class, pin, newer, reason: 'newer' | 'retired' | 'empty', hold: {at, by}}],
    blocked: [{class: string | null, cause, detail}], sessionsBehind: [{session, class, from, to, movedAt, turnAt,
    renderAt}], sessionsUnmeasured: [{session, why: 'advance-file-unreadable' | 'marker-absent' |
    'marker-unreadable' | 'sidecar-absent' | 'sidecar-unreadable'}]}]}`. `canary`, heldBehind's `reason`, `sessions`
    and both `sessionsUnmeasured` lists are this plan's additions to §3.9's shape
    (D-5220). The top-level list names each session whose `<sid>.wrapper` cannot be
    read (a session of no known lane, never skipped: D-4052's rule for the `codex` check); a lane's own list names
    each of its sessions it could not judge. `lanes` lists every roster row a registry can sit on whose
    `<id>.classes.json` exists, readable or not, in roster order.
  - Refusals: the roster's own words at exit 1 (`roster-absent`, `roster-unreadable`, `roster-invalid`); `bad-argv`
    at exit 2.

**What `advance-health` decides, per lane** (skeleton §3.9, as amended):
- **Every lane in the population:** `lock-unwritable` from its lock path (RC7), and its advance file's own word when
  that file is present and cannot be read or parsed.
- **A registry that cannot be read or parsed:** `registry-unreadable` or `registry-invalid`, whatever the lane's probe,
  and no finding after it for that lane.
- **Probe `codex` only** ("Codex findings apply to probe `codex`"):
  - `sessionsBehind`, judged against the advance file as the next locked writer will settle it (`reconcilePending`, in
    memory only: a hand set-class or an advance that a crash cut short counts as the move it was, and nothing is
    written); and `sessionsUnmeasured`, each of the lane's sessions it could not judge: all of them, as
    `advance-file-unreadable`, when the advance file is present and cannot be read or parsed; otherwise each whose
    turn marker or usage sidecar is absent, or cannot be read as one JSON object. A lane with no advance file has
    moved nothing, so no session of it is behind and none is unmeasured;
  - `lane-not-codex-kind` on a row that is not `exec.kind: "codex"`, and then nothing else, because such a lane never
    advances (D-5198);
  - the catalogue's own word, when it is present and cannot be read;
  - per class, in `CLASSES` order: `pin-grammar` and `shared-family` from `chooseCandidate`; a HELD class with a
    candidate in `heldBehind`, with `chooseCandidate`'s `reason` (`retired` is the one candidate that may be older
    than the pin), and never in `heldBack` (D-5221); an unheld class in `heldBack`
    when `heldBackOf` names its newest entry; and `windows-unreadable`, once per lane, when some unheld class has a
    candidate and the windows file cannot be read.


Append to the end of `server/test/model-advance-file.test.ts`:

```ts
// ── auto-advance plan W3 Task 14: whether one session is behind a move ───────────────────────────────────────
// `sessionBehind` is pure: the op reads the session's two files and hands their JSON here. These rows are the
// false positives the skeleton's Review Focus line 10 names (another class, a subagent's render, seconds against
// milliseconds, clock skew around the day), each one condition away from the positive case, and the inputs the
// rule must refuse rather than misread (a marker or sidecar that is not an object, a null model, a clock that is
// not a number). Neutral ids only.
describe('sessionBehind: one session still on a model a move replaced (§2.8; plan W3 Task 14)', () => {
  const ms = (iso: string): number => Date.parse(iso);
  /** The lane after ADVANCE_EXAMPLE's moves: each class on the model it moved to, the reverted class empty. */
  const PINS = reg({ haiku: 'model-6-alpha', sonnet: 'model-6-beta', opus: 'model-6.1-gamma' });
  const NOW = ms('2026-10-23T09:00:00Z');
  const MOVED = ms('2026-10-21T14:05:11Z');
  const TURN = ms('2026-10-22T09:11:40Z');
  const RENDER_S = ms('2026-10-22T09:12:03Z') / 1000;
  const turn = (o: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> =>
    ({ v: 1, sessionId: 'uuid-1', turnAt: TURN, ...o });
  const usage = (o: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> =>
    ({ ts: RENDER_S, uuid: 'uuid-1', model: 'model-5.6-gamma', agent: null, ...o });
  const BEHIND = { class: 'opus', from: 'model-5.6-gamma', to: 'model-6.1-gamma', movedAt: '2026-10-21T14:05:11Z',
    turnAt: '2026-10-22T09:11:40Z', renderAt: '2026-10-22T09:12:03Z' };
  interface Case { advance?: Advance; registry?: Registry; nowMs?: number; turn?: unknown; usage?: unknown }
  const judge = (c: Case = {}): ReturnType<typeof sessionBehind> => sessionBehind({
    advance: c.advance ?? ADVANCE_EXAMPLE, registry: c.registry ?? PINS, nowMs: c.nowMs ?? NOW,
    turn: c.turn === undefined ? turn() : c.turn, usage: c.usage === undefined ? usage() : c.usage,
  });

  it('a session still rendering the replaced model, in a turn begun after a move a day old, is behind, with the evidence', () => {
    expect(judge()).toEqual(BEHIND);
  });

  it('a move exactly a day old counts', () => {
    expect(judge({ nowMs: MOVED + BEHIND_AFTER_MS })).toEqual(BEHIND);
  });

  it('a revert is a move: a session still on the model it replaced is behind it, to an empty class', () => {
    // ADVANCE_EXAMPLE's fourth class advanced to model-6-delta, then was reverted to empty at 2026-10-22T08:00:00Z.
    const t = ms('2026-10-22T09:00:00Z');
    expect(judge({ turn: turn({ turnAt: t }), usage: usage({ model: 'model-6-delta', ts: t / 1000 + 60 }) }))
      .toEqual({ class: 'fable', from: 'model-6-delta', to: null, movedAt: '2026-10-22T08:00:00Z',
        turnAt: '2026-10-22T09:00:00Z', renderAt: '2026-10-22T09:01:00Z' });
  });

  it('a session two moves behind is still behind the move that replaced its model (D-5222)', () => {
    const opus = ADVANCE_EXAMPLE.classes.opus;
    const twice: Advance = { ...ADVANCE_EXAMPLE, classes: { ...ADVANCE_EXAMPLE.classes, opus: { ...opus, history: [
      { at: '2026-10-20T10:00:00Z', how: 'advance', from: 'model-5.6-gamma', to: 'model-6-gamma', ok: true, canary: 'passed' },
      { at: '2026-10-23T08:00:00Z', how: 'advance', from: 'model-6-gamma', to: 'model-6.1-gamma', ok: true, canary: 'passed' },
    ] } } };
    expect(judge({ advance: twice })).toEqual({ ...BEHIND, to: 'model-6-gamma', movedAt: '2026-10-20T10:00:00Z' });
    // The model the newest move replaced, an hour before `now`, is not yet a day behind.
    expect(judge({ advance: twice, usage: usage({ model: 'model-6-gamma' }) })).toBeNull();
  });

  it.each([
    ['a turn begun before the move is not evidence', { turn: turn({ turnAt: ms('2026-10-21T14:00:00Z') }) }],
    ['a move one second short of a day', { nowMs: MOVED + BEHIND_AFTER_MS - 1000 }],
    ['a move after `now` (a clock set back) never counts', { nowMs: ms('2026-10-21T00:00:00Z') }],
    ['a render of the new model', { usage: usage({ model: 'model-6.1-gamma' }) }],
    ['a session on another class\'s model', { usage: usage({ model: 'model-6-beta' }) }],
    ['a replaced model another class pins now',
      { registry: reg({ haiku: 'model-5.6-gamma', sonnet: 'model-6-beta', opus: 'model-6.1-gamma' }) }],
    ['a render from another Claude Code session (a /clear between them)', { usage: usage({ uuid: 'uuid-2' }) }],
    ['a subagent\'s render', { usage: usage({ agent: 'helper' }) }],
    ['a render from before the turn began', { usage: usage({ ts: TURN / 1000 - 60 }) }],
    ['a render in the turn\'s own second', { usage: usage({ ts: Math.floor(TURN / 1000) }) }],
    ['a sidecar ts in milliseconds', { usage: usage({ ts: RENDER_S * 1000 }) }],
    ['a sidecar ts that is not a whole number', { usage: usage({ ts: RENDER_S + 0.5 }) }],
    ['a marker whose turn was cleared', { turn: turn({ turnAt: null }) }],
    ['a marker turnAt in seconds reads as before every move', { turn: turn({ turnAt: TURN / 1000 }) }],
    ['a marker with no session id', { turn: turn({ sessionId: '' }) }],
    ['a marker that is not an object', { turn: null }],
    ['no sidecar at all', { usage: null }],
    // The status line writes `model: (.model.id // null)`. With all four classes pinned no class pins null, and
    // ADVANCE_EXAMPLE's fourth class holds a successful move FROM null (an empty class filled): only the model's
    // own type test keeps that move from reading as "behind, on null".
    ['a sidecar with no model, on a lane whose four classes are all pinned', {
      registry: reg({ haiku: 'model-6-alpha', sonnet: 'model-6-beta', opus: 'model-6.1-gamma', fable: 'model-6-delta' }),
      usage: usage({ model: null }) }],
    // A negative `ts` can never be later than a `turnAt` (an epoch, so never negative): a control, with no guard of
    // its own to remove.
    ['a render dated before 1970', { usage: usage({ ts: -1 }) }],
    // Every time comparison is written to FAIL on NaN, so a clock that is not a number is never evidence.
    ['a clock that is not a number', { nowMs: Number.NaN }],
    ['a failed move away from the model is not a move', {
      registry: reg({ opus: 'model-6.1-gamma' }), nowMs: ms('2026-10-24T12:00:00Z'),
      turn: turn({ turnAt: ms('2026-10-22T11:00:00Z') }),
      usage: usage({ model: 'model-6-beta', ts: ms('2026-10-22T11:01:00Z') / 1000 }) }],
  ] as [string, Case][])('%s: not behind', (_why, c) => {
    expect(judge(c)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('isoSeconds cuts an epoch in ms to the advance file\'s whole-second form, and refuses what a Date does not hold', () => {
    expect(isoSeconds(0)).toBe('1970-01-01T00:00:00Z');
    expect(isoSeconds(TURN + 999)).toBe('2026-10-22T09:11:40Z');
    for (const bad of [-1, 1.5, 8.64e15 + 1, Number.NaN]) expect(isoSeconds(bad)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('the threshold is one day, defined once, and lock-unwritable is a blocked word', () => {
    expect(BEHIND_AFTER_MS).toBe(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    expect(BLOCKED_CAUSES).toContain('lock-unwritable');
  });
});
```

```ts
// ── auto-advance plan W3 Task 14: `advance-health`, doctor's one read ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Box-wide and READ-ONLY. Its two paths come from its caller (`--reg`, `--lock-template`), so these cases put the
// session registry at the fixture's own `~/.cc-sessions` and the lock directory under a neutral `<home>/lk`: the op
// assumes neither. Every run is BOUNDED, because a reader that opened a FIFO would block inside the open. Neutral
// ids only; the one path outside the fixture HOME, `/var/tmp`, is only lstat-ed and access-ed, never written.
describe('advance-health (auto-advance spec §2.8; plan W3 Task 14)', () => {
  const H_NOW = '2026-10-23T09:00:00Z';
  const H_MOVED = '2026-10-21T14:05:11Z';
  const H_TURN = '2026-10-22T09:11:40Z';
  const H_RENDER = '2026-10-22T09:12:03Z';
  const H_SID = 'lane-a-demo';
  const isRootH = typeof process.getuid === 'function' && process.getuid() === 0;
  const sessDir = (): string => path.join(home, '.cc-sessions');
  const lockDir = (): string => path.join(home, 'lk');
  const lockTpl = (): string => path.join(lockDir(), 'models-{id}.lock');
  const lockOf = (id = 'lane-a'): string => path.join(lockDir(), `models-${id}.lock`);

  /** `advance-health`, ended at 20 s: a hang reds the case, never the suite. `args` replaces the whole argument
   *  list after the op's name. */
  function health(o: { now?: string; args?: string[] } = {}): Result {
    const args = o.args ?? ['--file', rosterPath(), '--reg', sessDir(), '--lock-template', lockTpl()];
    const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [OP, 'advance-health', ...args],
      { env: { ...process.env, HOME: home, CCRC_MODELS_NOW: o.now ?? H_NOW }, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 20_000 });
    expect(r.signal, `advance-health was ended at the bound: ${r.stderr}`).toBeNull();
    const stdout = r.stdout ?? '';
    const lines = stdout.split('\n');
    expect(lines.length, `stdout carried ${lines.length - 1} lines, not one`).toBe(2);
    return { code: r.status ?? -1, body: JSON.parse(lines[0]!), stderr: r.stderr ?? '', stdout };
  }
  const laneH = (r: Result, id = 'lane-a'): Record<string, unknown> =>
    (r.body['lanes'] as Record<string, unknown>[]).find((l) => l['id'] === id)!;

  /** A lane's files as their writers leave them, with NO materialise: this op reads no settings, and a pin that
   *  breaks the grammar is one no materialise should be asked to render. `null` leaves that file absent. */
  function plantH(o: { id?: string; registry?: unknown; catalogue?: unknown; advance?: unknown } = {}): void {
    const id = o.id ?? 'lane-a';
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(home, '.ccrc', 'models'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(regPath(id), `${JSON.stringify(o.registry ?? STEP_REGISTRY, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    if (o.catalogue !== null) writeCatalogue(id, o.catalogue ?? STEP_CATALOGUE);
    if (o.advance !== null) {
      fs.writeFileSync(advPath(id), `${JSON.stringify(o.advance ?? stepAdvance(), null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    }
  }
  /** lane-a after one advance: opus moved from model-5.6-gamma to model-6.1-gamma at H_MOVED. */
  const MOVED_REG = { ...STEP_REGISTRY, classes: { ...STEP_REGISTRY.classes, opus: 'model-6.1-gamma' },
    effort: { ...STEP_REGISTRY.effort, opus: 'xhigh' } };
  const MOVE = { at: H_MOVED, how: 'advance', from: 'model-5.6-gamma', to: 'model-6.1-gamma', ok: true,
    canary: 'passed', effort: { from: 'max', to: 'xhigh' } };
  const MOVED_ADV = stepAdvance({ opus: { previous: { model: 'model-5.6-gamma', effort: 'max' }, history: [MOVE] } });
  /** opus's advance refused three times: the newest entry, a failed advance to the class's standing candidate. */
  const failedH = (o: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> => ({
    at: '2026-10-22T10:05:12Z', how: 'advance', from: 'model-5.6-gamma', to: 'model-6.1-gamma', ok: false,
    canary: 'failed', reason: 'http 500: upstream error', tries: 3, lastAt: '2026-10-22T12:05:09Z', ...o });
  const HOLD = { at: '2026-10-22T08:00:00Z', by: 'hand' };

  /** One session's three registry files, as ccd, the session hook and the status line write them. `sidecar: null`
   *  writes no usage sidecar; a string is written as the sidecar verbatim. */
  function plantSessionH(o: { sid?: string; lane?: string; model?: string; sidecar?: string | null } = {}): void {
    const sid = o.sid ?? H_SID;
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(sessDir(), 'usage'), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(sessDir(), `${sid}.wrapper`), o.lane ?? 'lane-a');
    const turnAt = Date.parse(H_TURN);

      state: 'done', event: 'Stop', at: turnAt + 30_000, turnAt, stopAt: turnAt + 30_000, bg: -1, bgKinds: '',
      bgIds: '', err: null, restartAt: null, lostBg: 0, lostKinds: '', lostIds: '' })}\n`);
    if (o.sidecar === null) return;
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(sessDir(), 'usage', `${sid}.json`), o.sidecar ?? `${JSON.stringify({
      ts: Date.parse(H_RENDER) / 1000, uuid: `uuid-${sid}`, account: o.lane ?? 'lane-a',
      model: o.model ?? 'model-5.6-gamma', effort: 'low', ctxPct: 12, cost: 0.1, agent: null })}\n`);

    plantH({ registry: MOVED_REG, advance: stepAdvance({}, { how: 'hand', class: 'opus', from: 'model-5.6-gamma',

    ['a relative lock template', (): string[] => ['--file', rosterPath(), '--reg', sessDir(), '--lock-template', 'lk/models-{id}.lock']],
    ['no --lock-template', (): string[] => ['--file', rosterPath(), '--reg', sessDir()]],
    ['no --reg', (): string[] => ['--file', rosterPath(), '--lock-template', lockTpl()]],
    ['an --id, which a box-wide op does not take', (): string[] =>

  ] as [string, () => string[]][])('%s is bad-argv at exit 2', (_w, args) => {
```

Append at the end of `shared/model-advance.mjs`:

```js
// ── SESSIONS BEHIND A MOVE (§2.8; plan W3 Task 14) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// `model-sessions-behind` is the backstop for a running session that kept a model a move replaced: the plan's
// Task 1 measured that a running session does not reliably pick up a re-pin by itself. This half decides, from the
// evidence its caller read (the session's main-thread turn marker and its status line's usage sidecar), whether one
// session is behind. Still pure: it reads no file and no clock. `isoSeconds` formats a time it is handed.

/** How long after a move a session still on the model it replaced counts as behind: one day (§2.8). Defined once,
 *  here, for the op and for any later reader of its answer. */
export const BEHIND_AFTER_MS = 86_400_000;
/** The largest epoch, in ms, a JS `Date` holds. */
const EPOCH_MS_MAX = 8.64e15;
/** A usage sidecar's `ts` is whole SECONDS (the status line writes `date +%s`). A value past this is not seconds
 *  (thirteen digits of milliseconds, say) and is never compared, so a writer that slipped into milliseconds can never
 *  make a render look newer than every turn. 99999999999 s is in the year 5138. */
const SIDECAR_TS_MAX_S = 99_999_999_999;
const isEpochMs = (v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v <= EPOCH_MS_MAX;

/** `(ms) => 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' | null`: an epoch in ms in the advance file's own time form, cut to whole
 *  seconds; null for anything that is not an epoch a `Date` holds. It formats the time it is handed and never reads
 *  the clock. */
export function isoSeconds(ms) {
  if (!isEpochMs(ms)) return null;
  return new Date(ms).toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z');
}

/**
 * `({advance, registry, nowMs, turn, usage}) => {class, from, to, movedAt, turnAt, renderAt} | null`: whether ONE
 * session of a lane is behind a move (§2.8). It names the evidence, the render and the turn, not a ccd reason
 * (D-5194). The caller has matched the session to the lane (its registry `.wrapper`)
 * and parsed its two files; `turn` and `usage` are whatever JSON they held, and are checked here. Behind means ALL of:
 *  1. the marker names a main-thread turn: `sessionId` a non-empty string, `turnAt` an epoch in ms;
 *  2. the sidecar is the session's own main-loop render of that same Claude Code session: `ts` whole seconds;
 *     `agent` null or absent (a subagent's render goes to a file of its own, and one that names an agent here is not
 *     the main loop's); `uuid` equal to the marker's `sessionId` (a `/clear` between them rotates it); `model` an id;
 *  3. the render came after that turn began: `ts`, read as ms, strictly later than `turnAt`. A render in the same
 *     second may predate the turn, so it is not evidence;
 *  4. no class of the lane pins that model now: a session on another class's model is not behind;
 *  5. some class's history holds a SUCCESSFUL move away from that model, at least `BEHIND_AFTER_MS` before `nowMs`,
 *     and the turn began after it. A move after `nowMs` (a clock set back) never counts. The NEWEST such entry of each
 *     class is judged, not only the class's newest move, so a session two moves behind is still behind
 *     (D-5222). Classes are tried in `CLASSES` order; the first that holds answers.
 * Anything else is null: an input it cannot read is never a finding (§2.8, "failures fail shut"). Every time test is
 * written as a comparison that HOLDS for evidence, negated, so a NaN fails it: a clock that is not a number, a move
 * time that does not parse and a render dated before 1970 (never later than a turn, which is never negative) are
 * each "not behind" with no guard of their own. The caller (`advance-health`) names, apart, a session whose files it
 * could not read as JSON objects; this rule only judges what it is handed.
 */
export function sessionBehind({ advance, registry, nowMs, turn, usage }) {
  if (!isObj(turn) || !isObj(usage)) return null;
  const sid = turn.sessionId;
  const turnAt = turn.turnAt;
  if (typeof sid !== 'string' || sid === '' || !isEpochMs(turnAt)) return null;
  const { ts, uuid, model, agent } = usage;
  if (!Number.isInteger(ts) || ts > SIDECAR_TS_MAX_S) return null;
  if (agent !== undefined && agent !== null) return null;
  if (uuid !== sid || typeof model !== 'string' || model === '') return null;
  const renderMs = ts * 1000;
  if (!(renderMs > turnAt)) return null;
  if (CLASSES.some((c) => registry.classes[c] === model)) return null;
  for (const cls of CLASSES) {
    const history = advance.classes[cls].history;
    let move = null;
    for (let i = history.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      if (history[i].ok === true && history[i].from === model) { move = history[i]; break; }
    }
    if (move === null) continue;
    const movedMs = Date.parse(move.at);
    if (!(movedMs <= nowMs - BEHIND_AFTER_MS) || !(turnAt > movedMs)) continue;
    return { class: cls, from: move.from, to: move.to, movedAt: move.at, turnAt: isoSeconds(turnAt),
      renderAt: isoSeconds(renderMs) };
  }
  return null;
}
```

Insert immediately before the docstring that begins ``/** `--key value` pairs, refused rather than ignored`` (the
docstring of `readPairs`):

```js
// ── `advance-health` (auto-advance spec §2.8; plan W3 Task 14) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
// The one read behind `ccrc doctor`'s four model-advance checks. BOX-WIDE and READ-ONLY: it reads every lane's
// model files, the session registry and each lane's lock path, and it writes nothing, takes no lock and never opens
// a lock path. Its answer's shape is the plan's §3.9, plus `canary` on each held-back class, `reason` on each
// held-behind class, the session registry's own word, and the sessions it could not measure, at the top level (a
// `.wrapper` it cannot read) and on each lane (D-5220).

/** The largest `<sid>.wrapper` read (a lane id, at most 32 characters, and no newline). */
const WRAPPER_FILE_MAX_BYTES = 256;
/** The largest turn marker or usage sidecar read: the marker's own writer-side cap (`server/src/turnmark.ts`), and
 *  far above a sidecar's one line. */
const SESSION_FILE_MAX_BYTES = 4096;
/** A ccd session id as a file name: the status line's own charset (`ccd/statusline-command.sh`), led by a letter or
 *  digit so no dotted temporary file is ever read as a session. */
const SESSION_ID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$/;

/** A session registry file, type-tested and SIZE-tested before it is read (`readRegular` reads a file whole): a FIFO
 *  or a directory throws `ENOTREG`, an oversized file `ETOOBIG`, so no session file can block or flood this op. */
function readSessionFile(p, maxBytes) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (!st.isFile()) throw Object.assign(new Error('not a regular file'), { code: 'ENOTREG' });
  if (st.size > maxBytes) throw Object.assign(new Error(`over ${maxBytes} bytes`), { code: 'ETOOBIG' });
  return readRegular(p);
}

/** Whether a writer could take the lane-files lock at `p`, measured READ-ONLY with `lstat` and `access(W_OK)` only:
 *  never an open (a FIFO would block it), never a create, never the lock itself (D-5193). The
 *  answer is the sentence `model-advance-blocked` prints, or null when nothing stands in the way. It names every
 *  case `_models_lock` (W1, `ccd/ccrc`) refuses `lock-unwritable`, and, by ruling RC7's letter ("whose lock
 *  directory it cannot write"), one case that writer repairs instead of refusing:
 *   - the directory: absent is not a finding (the first lock makes it); a symlink is, anything but a directory is,
 *     one another account owns is (lstat's `uid`: its `chmod 700` would fail, even where `access` says writable;
 *     root can chmod any), and so is one this account cannot write. That last one, on a directory this account
 *     owns, is the RC7 case: the next writer's `chmod 700` makes it writable, and the remedy says so;
 *   - the file: absent is not a finding; a symlink (live or dangling) is, anything but a regular file (a FIFO, a
 *     directory, a socket) is, and so is one this account cannot write (its `>>` open would fail). */
function lockUnwritable(p) {
  const d = path.dirname(p);
  const uid = typeof process.getuid === 'function' ? process.getuid() : null;
  let ds;
  try {
    ds = lstatSync(d);
  } catch (e) {
    return e.code === 'ENOENT' ? null : `${d} could not be examined (${e.code ?? e.message})`;
  }
  if (ds.isSymbolicLink()) return `${d} is a symlink, which the lane-files lock never follows`;
  if (!ds.isDirectory()) return `${d} is not a directory`;
  if (uid !== null && uid !== 0 && ds.uid !== uid) {
    return `${d} belongs to another account (uid ${ds.uid}), so the lane-files lock cannot make it 0700`;
  }
  try {
    accessSync(d, fsConstants.W_OK);
  } catch (e) {
    return `${d} is not writable by this account (${e.code ?? e.message})`;
  }
  let fst;
  try {
    fst = lstatSync(p);
  } catch (e) {
    return e.code === 'ENOENT' ? null : `${p} could not be examined (${e.code ?? e.message})`;
  }
  if (fst.isSymbolicLink()) return `${p} is a symlink, which the lane-files lock never opens`;
  if (!fst.isFile()) {
    return `${p} is not a regular file (a FIFO, a directory or a socket), which the lane-files lock never opens`;
  }
  try {
    accessSync(p, fsConstants.W_OK);
  } catch (e) {
    return `${p} is not writable by this account (${e.code ?? e.message})`;
  }
  return null;
}

/** The session registry, listed ONCE per op: each session's lane, read from its `<sid>.wrapper` (ccd's field, a
 *  lane id with no newline). `state` keeps three answers apart: `read`, `absent` (no directory: no session to
 *  measure) and `unreadable` (it cannot be listed: no session was measured, which doctor must never read as none).
 *  A `.wrapper` that cannot be read is a session of NO KNOWN LANE, which may be on any lane: it is never skipped, and
 *  goes in `unlaned` as `wrapper-unreadable` (D-4052's rule for the `codex` check, ccrc-doctor-checks'
 *  `_dr_cx_sessions`). A name that is not a session id (a dotted temporary file, say) is no session at all. */
function sessionIndex(reg) {
  let names;
  try {
    names = readdirSync(reg);
  } catch (e) {
    return { state: e.code === 'ENOENT' ? 'absent' : 'unreadable', byLane: new Map(), unlaned: [] };
  }
  const byLane = new Map();
  const unlaned = [];
  for (const n of [...names].sort()) {
    if (!n.endsWith('.wrapper')) continue;
    const sid = n.slice(0, -'.wrapper'.length);
    if (!SESSION_ID_RE.test(sid)) continue;
    let lane;
    try {
      lane = readSessionFile(path.join(reg, n), WRAPPER_FILE_MAX_BYTES).split('\n')[0];
    } catch {
      unlaned.push({ session: sid, why: 'wrapper-unreadable' });
      continue;
    }
    if (!byLane.has(lane)) byLane.set(lane, []);
    byLane.get(lane).push(sid);
  }
  return { state: 'read', byLane, unlaned };
}

/** One session file as one JSON object, or the word for why not: `absent` (ENOENT, the file or its directory) or
 *  `unreadable` (every other read failure: not a regular file, over its cap, a permission; or text that is not one
 *  JSON object). Two words, never folded: a session with no sidecar is a home whose status line writes none, a
 *  broken sidecar is a fault. */
function readSessionJson(p) {
  let raw;
  try {
    raw = readSessionFile(p, SESSION_FILE_MAX_BYTES);
  } catch (e) {
    return { why: e.code === 'ENOENT' ? 'absent' : 'unreadable' };
  }
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(raw);
    return isObj(v) ? { value: v } : { why: 'unreadable' };
  } catch {
    return { why: 'unreadable' };
  }
}

/** The lane's sessions behind a move (`sessionBehind`, the pure rule), from each session's turn marker
 *  (`<sid>.turn.json`) and its main-loop usage sidecar (`usage/<sid>.json`, never a subagent's `usage/<sid>.agents/`),
 *  and the sessions it could not judge. A session whose marker or sidecar is absent, or cannot be read as one JSON
 *  object, is never listed as behind and never silently passed: it goes in `unmeasured` with the first file that
 *  failed and why (D-5220). A session the rule reads and finds not behind is measured. */
function sessionsBehindOf(id, ctx, advance, registry) {
  const behind = [];
  const unmeasured = [];
  for (const session of ctx.sessions.byLane.get(id) ?? []) {
    const turn = readSessionJson(path.join(ctx.reg, `${session}.turn.json`));
    if (turn.why !== undefined) {
      unmeasured.push({ session, why: turn.why === 'absent' ? 'marker-absent' : 'marker-unreadable' });
      continue;
    }
    const usage = readSessionJson(path.join(ctx.reg, 'usage', `${session}.json`));
    if (usage.why !== undefined) {
      unmeasured.push({ session, why: usage.why === 'absent' ? 'sidecar-absent' : 'sidecar-unreadable' });
      continue;
    }
    const b = sessionBehind({ advance, registry, nowMs: ctx.nowMs, turn: turn.value, usage: usage.value });
    if (b !== null) behind.push({ session, ...b });
  }
  return { behind, unmeasured };
}

/** One lane's findings, or null for a lane with no registry FILE (not in the population). The order of `blocked`
 *  is fixed: the lock, the advance file, then the registry, the lane's kind or the catalogue, then each class in
 *  `CLASSES` order, then the windows file.
 *   - Every lane in the population: its lock path, and its advance file when that is present and unreadable.
 *   - A registry that cannot be read or parsed is reported whatever the lane's probe, and ends the lane.
 *   - Everything else is for probe `codex` alone. `sessionsBehind` is judged against the advance file as the next
 *     locked writer will settle it (`reconcilePending`, in memory: a move a crash cut short counts as the move it
 *     was, D-5188, and nothing is written); `sessionsUnmeasured` names each session it could
 *     not judge: every one of the lane's, as `advance-file-unreadable`, when the advance file cannot be read (its
 *     moves are unknown), else those `sessionsBehindOf` could not read. With no advance file nothing has moved, so
 *     no session is read. A row that is not `exec.kind: "codex"` is `lane-not-codex-kind` and nothing more
 *     (D-5198): it never advances.
 *   - Per class: `chooseCandidate`'s `pin-grammar` and `shared-family`; a HELD class with a candidate is
 *     `heldBehind`, with `chooseCandidate`'s `reason` (`retired` names a fallback that may be older than the pin),
 *     never `heldBack`, because the hold stopped its retries (D-5221); an unheld class whose
 *     newest entry `heldBackOf` names is `heldBack`, with the step that failed; and the windows file blocks the lane
 *     once when some unheld class has a candidate and that file cannot be read. */
function laneHealth(acc, ctx) {
  const id = acc.id;
  const cat = readCatalogue(id);
  const reg = readRegistry(id, cat.err !== undefined ? null : cat.catalogue);
  if (reg.err === undefined && reg.invalid === undefined && reg.registry === null) return null;
  const lane = { id, heldBack: [], heldBehind: [], blocked: [], sessionsBehind: [], sessionsUnmeasured: [] };
  const block = (cls, cause, detail) => { lane.blocked.push({ class: cls, cause, detail }); };
  const lockWhy = lockUnwritable(ctx.lockTemplate.replace('{id}', id));
  if (lockWhy !== null) block(null, 'lock-unwritable', lockWhy);
  const rd = readAdvance(id);
  if (rd.err !== undefined) block(null, rd.err[0], rd.err[1]);
  if (reg.err !== undefined) {
    block(null, reg.err[0], reg.err[1]);
    return lane;
  }
  if (reg.invalid !== undefined) {
    block(null, 'registry-invalid', reg.invalid.message);
    return lane;
  }
  const registry = reg.registry;
  if (registry.probe !== 'codex') return lane;
  const adv = rd.err !== undefined || rd.advance === null ? null : reconcilePending(rd.advance, registry).advance;
  if (rd.err !== undefined) {
    lane.sessionsUnmeasured = (ctx.sessions.byLane.get(id) ?? [])
      .map((session) => ({ session, why: 'advance-file-unreadable' }));
  } else if (adv !== null) {
    const s = sessionsBehindOf(id, ctx, adv, registry);
    lane.sessionsBehind = s.behind;
    lane.sessionsUnmeasured = s.unmeasured;
  }
  if (!(isObj(acc.exec) && acc.exec.kind === 'codex')) {
    const kind = isObj(acc.exec) && typeof acc.exec.kind === 'string' ? acc.exec.kind : 'none';
    block(null, 'lane-not-codex-kind', `its roster row is exec.kind "${kind}", and only an exec.kind "codex" lane advances`);
    return lane;
  }
  if (cat.err !== undefined) {
    block(null, cat.err[0], cat.err[1]);
    return lane;
  }
  const win = readWindowsFile(id);
  let waiting = false;
  for (const cls of CLASSES) {
    const c = adv === null ? null : adv.classes[cls];
    const pin = registry.classes[cls] ?? null;
    const choice = chooseCandidate({ registry, catalogue: cat.catalogue, cls, family: c === null ? null : c.family });
    if (choice.blocked === 'pin-grammar') block(cls, 'pin-grammar', `${pin} is not <vendor>-<version>-<family>`);
    if (choice.blocked === 'shared-family') {
      const fam = (c === null ? null : c.family) ?? familyOf(pin);
      const others = CLASSES.filter((o) => o !== cls && familyOf(registry.classes[o] ?? null) === fam);
      block(cls, 'shared-family',
        `family ${fam} is followed by ${[cls, ...others].join(' and ')}, and its newest model is already another class's pin`);
    }
    if (c !== null && c.hold !== null) {
      if (choice.candidate !== null) {
        lane.heldBehind.push({ class: cls, pin, newer: choice.candidate, reason: choice.reason, hold: c.hold });
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (choice.candidate !== null && choice.blocked === null) waiting = true;
    if (c === null) continue;
    const back = heldBackOf(c, choice.candidate);
    if (back !== null) {
      lane.heldBack.push({ class: cls, from: back.from, to: back.to, reason: back.reason ?? null,
        tries: back.tries ?? 1, since: back.at, canary: back.canary });
    }
  }
  if (waiting && win.state === 'unreadable') block(null, 'windows-unreadable', win.reason);
  return lane;
}

/** `advance-health` (auto-advance spec §2.8; plan W3 Task 14): box-wide and READ-ONLY. Every roster row a registry
 *  can sit on (`canCarryRegistry`) whose registry FILE exists, readable or not, in roster order; a row with none is
 *  not in the population. `--reg` is the session registry and `--lock-template` the lane-files lock path with `{id}`
 *  in place of the lane, both from `ccd/ccrc` (`$_SVC_REG`, `_models_lock_path '{id}'`), so this file spells neither
 *  (D-5219). Each is checked after the roster read (`main` reads the roster before it
 *  dispatches any op, so with no roster the answer is the roster's own word) and before any lane file or session
 *  file is read: an absolute `--reg`, and an absolute template holding `{id}` exactly once. */
function advanceHealthOp(a, json) {
  if (!path.isAbsolute(a.reg)) {
    return refuse(2, 'bad-argv', `--reg must be the session registry's absolute path (got ${JSON.stringify(a.reg)}).`);
  }
  const tpl = a['lock-template'];
  if (!path.isAbsolute(tpl) || tpl.split('{id}').length !== 2) {
    return refuse(2, 'bad-argv',
      `--lock-template must be an absolute path holding {id} exactly once (got ${JSON.stringify(tpl)}).`);
  }
  const at = now();
  const nowMs = Date.parse(at);
  if (!Number.isFinite(nowMs)) return refuse(2, 'bad-argv', `the clock answered ${JSON.stringify(at)}, which is not a time.`);
  const sessions = sessionIndex(a.reg);
  const ctx = { nowMs, reg: a.reg, sessions, lockTemplate: tpl };
  const lanes = [];
  for (const acc of (json.accounts ?? [])) {
    if (!isObj(acc) || !canCarryRegistry(acc) || typeof acc.id !== 'string' || !ACCOUNT_ID_RE.test(acc.id)) continue;
    const lane = laneHealth(acc, ctx);
    if (lane !== null) lanes.push(lane);
  }
  out({ ok: true, op: 'advance-health', now: at, sessions: sessions.state, sessionsUnmeasured: sessions.unlaned, lanes });
  return 0;
}
```

In `main`, immediately before the line `  const account = findAccount(json, a.id);`, add:

```js
  // Auto-advance plan W3 Task 14: doctor's one read of every lane's advance state. Box-wide like `lanes` above: it
  // takes no --id, so it is answered before any one account is looked up.
  if (opName === 'advance-health') return advanceHealthOp(a, json);
```
