  globals `DR_MA_JSON`, `DR_MA_LANES` and `DR_MA_JQ_DEFS`. The verdict lines, exactly:

```
WARN model-advance-held-back: <id> <class> stays on <from|none>: <to> failed its canary <N> times since <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>Z (<reason>)
WARN model-advance-held-back: <id> <class> stays on <from|none>: moving to <to> failed once, at <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>Z (<reason>)
  remedy: the next hourly refresh retries it; 'ccrc models <id> show' shows the class, and 'ccrc models <id> hold <class>' stops the retries
WARN model-held-behind: <id> <class> is held (<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>Z, by <hand|revert>) while <newer> is newer in its family
WARN model-held-behind: <id> <class> is held (<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>Z, by <hand|revert>) on <pin>, which has left the catalogue; <newer> is the newest left in its family
  remedy: 'ccrc models <id> release <class>' lets the next hourly refresh advance it, canary first
WARN model-sessions-behind: <id> session <sid> last replied on <from> at <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM>Z, in a turn begun <HH:MM>Z, <H> h after <class> moved to <to|none><tail>
  remedy: a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself: once it is idle, relaunch it with 'ccd stop <sid>' then 'ccd start <sid>'; it resumes its conversation, and one with no class in its routing record may come back on its old model
WARN model-advance-blocked: <id>: <cause> (<detail>); <id> <class>: <cause> (<detail>)
  remedy: per cause: <one clause per cause, joined with "; ">
PASS <check>: <N> lane(s) with a model registry: <what was measured><tail>
SKIP <check>: <why there was nothing to measure>
```

  One WARN line per lane, its findings joined with `_dr_join`; a lane with several classes or sessions gets the
  remedy's plural form, naming them. `<H>` is whole hours from the move to `now`, rounded down. The second
  `model-held-behind` form is a held class whose pin has left the catalogue (`reason: retired`), whose fallback may
  be older than the pin. `<tail>` is `model-sessions-behind`'s alone, on its PASS line and on every one of its WARN
  lines, and is box-wide: `; <n> listed session(s) not running`, `; <n> listed session(s) whose state the service
  manager did not report` and `; <n> session(s) could not be measured (<why> <n>, …)`, each present only when its
  count is not 0, the last grouped by why in sorted order.

```ts
// The four model-advance doctor checks (auto-advance spec §2.8; plan W3 Task 15): `model-advance-held-back`,
// `model-held-behind`, `model-sessions-behind` and `model-advance-blocked`. Each runs as `cmd_doctor` runs it: `ccd/ccrc`
// sourced, `ccrc-doctor-checks` sourced beside it, then the one `_check_<name>`, against fixture files read through

//
// CONTAINED. HOME is a `mkTmp` directory with a deployed box's shape (`<home>/ccrc/ccd/ccrc`, with `deploy` and
// `shared` beside it); `ghContainedEnv` poisons gh and the service managers; and `_svc_is_active`, the one question
// these checks ask a service manager, is redefined to answer from `<home>/svc/<unit>` and to record every unit it is
// asked about. Nothing here reaches tmux, the live `~/.cc-sessions`, `~/.cc-limits` or a `claude-session@` unit.
// Fixture lanes are `lane-a` (codex-kind) and `lane-b` (external-kind, or codex-kind where a case says so); every
// model id is neutral.

import fs from 'node:fs';
import path, { join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

import { ghContainedEnv } from './ccdWsHelpers.js';
import { codexAuthDir } from './codexLaneFixture.js';
import { STEP_CATALOGUE, STEP_REGISTRY, stepAdvance, stepRoster } from './fixtures/advanceCases.js';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = path.resolve(here, '..', '..');
const BASH = spawnSync('bash', ['-c', 'command -v bash'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).stdout.trim();
const CHECKS = ['model-advance-held-back', 'model-held-behind', 'model-sessions-behind', 'model-advance-blocked'] as const;
type Check = typeof CHECKS[number];

const NOW = '2026-10-23T09:00:00Z';
const MOVED = '2026-10-21T14:05:11Z';
const TURN = '2026-10-22T09:11:40Z';
const RENDER = '2026-10-22T09:12:03Z';
const SID = 'lane-a-demo';
const LANE_A = { proxyPort: 45050, litellmPort: 45051, authDir: codexAuthDir('lane-a') };
const LANE_B = { proxyPort: 45052, litellmPort: 45053, authDir: codexAuthDir('lane-b') };
type Json = Record<string, unknown>;

const homes: string[] = [];
afterEach(() => { for (const h of homes.splice(0)) fs.rmSync(h, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

/** A box: `ccd/ccrc`, its check table and the wrapper-shape contract linked one by one, and `deploy` and `shared`
 *  linked whole (node resolves models-op's imports from their real path, this checkout's), then the roster.
 *  `laneB` makes lane-b codex-kind too; `stuckOp` puts a real `deploy/` in place whose `models-op.mjs` never answers. */
function box(o: { laneB?: boolean; stuckOp?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const h = mkTmp('doctor-model-advance-');
  homes.push(h);
  const ccd = join(h, 'ccrc', 'ccd');
  fs.mkdirSync(ccd, { recursive: true });
  for (const f of ['ccrc', 'ccrc-doctor-checks', 'ccrc-wrapper-shape']) fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'ccd', f), join(ccd, f));
  if (o.stuckOp) {
    fs.mkdirSync(join(h, 'ccrc', 'deploy'));
    fs.writeFileSync(join(h, 'ccrc', 'deploy', 'models-op.mjs'), 'setTimeout(() => {}, 120_000);\n');
  } else {
    fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'deploy'), join(h, 'ccrc', 'deploy'));
  }
  fs.symlinkSync(join(REPO, 'shared'), join(h, 'ccrc', 'shared'));
  fs.mkdirSync(join(h, '.ccrc', 'models'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(join(h, '.ccrc', 'accounts.json'),
    `${JSON.stringify(stepRoster(LANE_A, o.laneB ? LANE_B : undefined), null, 2)}\n`);
  return h;
}

/** One lane's model files, as their writers leave them. `null` leaves that file absent. */
function plantLane(h: string, o: { id?: string; registry?: Json | null; catalogue?: Json | null; advance?: Json | null } = {}): void {
  const id = o.id ?? 'lane-a';
  const dir = join(h, '.ccrc', 'models');
  if (o.registry === null) fs.rmSync(join(dir, `${id}.classes.json`), { force: true });
  else fs.writeFileSync(join(dir, `${id}.classes.json`), `${JSON.stringify(o.registry ?? STEP_REGISTRY, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
  if (o.catalogue !== null) fs.writeFileSync(join(dir, `${id}.json`), JSON.stringify(o.catalogue ?? STEP_CATALOGUE));
  if (o.advance !== null) {
    fs.writeFileSync(join(dir, `${id}.advance.json`), `${JSON.stringify(o.advance ?? stepAdvance(), null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
  }
}

/** lane-a after one advance: opus moved from model-5.6-gamma to model-6.1-gamma at MOVED. */
const MOVED_REGISTRY = { ...STEP_REGISTRY, classes: { ...STEP_REGISTRY.classes, opus: 'model-6.1-gamma' },
  effort: { ...STEP_REGISTRY.effort, opus: 'xhigh' } };
const MOVE = { at: MOVED, how: 'advance', from: 'model-5.6-gamma', to: 'model-6.1-gamma', ok: true, canary: 'passed',
  effort: { from: 'max', to: 'xhigh' } };
const MOVED_ADVANCE = stepAdvance({ opus: { previous: { model: 'model-5.6-gamma', effort: 'max' }, history: [MOVE] } });
/** A failed advance of opus to its standing candidate, its canary refused three times. */
const failed = (o: Json = {}): Json => ({ at: '2026-10-22T10:05:12Z', how: 'advance', from: 'model-5.6-gamma',
  to: 'model-6.1-gamma', ok: false, canary: 'failed', reason: 'http 500: upstream error', tries: 3,
  lastAt: '2026-10-22T12:05:09Z', ...o });
const HOLD = { at: '2026-10-22T08:00:00Z', by: 'hand' };

/** One session's registry row, turn marker and usage sidecar. `svc` is the word the service manager answers for its
 *  unit (default `active`); `null` leaves it unanswered. `sidecar: false` writes no usage sidecar (a home whose
 *  status line writes none). */
function plantSession(h: string,
  o: { sid?: string; lane?: string; model?: string; svc?: string | null; sidecar?: boolean } = {}): void {
  const sid = o.sid ?? SID;
  const reg = join(h, '.cc-sessions');
  fs.mkdirSync(join(reg, 'usage'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(join(reg, `${sid}.wrapper`), o.lane ?? 'lane-a');
  const turnAt = Date.parse(TURN);
  fs.writeFileSync(join(reg, `${sid}.turn.json`), `${JSON.stringify({ v: 1, sessionId: `uuid-${sid}`, state: 'done',
    event: 'Stop', at: turnAt + 30_000, turnAt, stopAt: turnAt + 30_000, bg: -1, bgKinds: '', bgIds: '', err: null,
    restartAt: null, lostBg: 0, lostKinds: '', lostIds: '' })}\n`);
  if (o.sidecar !== false) {
    fs.writeFileSync(join(reg, 'usage', `${sid}.json`), `${JSON.stringify({ ts: Date.parse(RENDER) / 1000,
      uuid: `uuid-${sid}`, account: o.lane ?? 'lane-a', model: o.model ?? 'model-5.6-gamma', effort: 'low', ctxPct: 12,
      cost: 0.1, agent: null })}\n`);
  }
  if (o.svc === null) return;
  fs.mkdirSync(join(h, 'svc'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(join(h, 'svc', `claude-session@${sid}.service`), `${o.svc ?? 'active'}\n`);
}

/** `_svc_is_active`, redefined after the library is sourced: it answers the word in `<home>/svc/<unit>` (nothing
 *  when there is none: the manager did not answer) and appends every unit it is asked about to `<home>/svc-asked`.
 *  Builtins only. */
const SVC_FAKE = [
  '_svc_is_active() {',
  '  local w=""',
  '  printf \'%s\\n\' "$1" >> "$HOME/svc-asked"',
  '  if [ -f "$HOME/svc/$1" ]; then IFS= read -r w < "$HOME/svc/$1" || :; fi',
  '  printf \'%s\' "$w"',
  '}',
].join('\n');

interface Run { code: number; out: string; err: string; ms: number }
/** One check, as `cmd_doctor` runs it. A runner's own knobs never steer a case; `CCRC_MODELS_NOW` fixes the op's
 *  clock. Ended at 30 s, so a check that hangs reds its case, never the suite. */
function check(h: string, name: Check, extra: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = {}): Run {
  const inherited: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = { ...process.env };
  for (const k of ['CCRC_MODELS_NOW', 'CCRC_DOCTOR_GH_TIMEOUT', 'CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S', 'CCRC_ROLE', 'CCD_TIMEOUT_KILL_AFTER']) {
    delete inherited[k];
  }
  const env = { ...ghContainedEnv(h, { ...inherited, HOME: h }, { systemd: true }), CCRC_MODELS_NOW: NOW, ...extra };
  const script = ['umask 022', `. "${join(h, 'ccrc', 'ccd', 'ccrc')}"`, '. "$CCRC_HERE/ccrc-doctor-checks"', SVC_FAKE,
    `_check_${name}`].join('\n');
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = spawnSync(BASH, ['-c', script], { env, encoding: 'utf8', input: '', timeout: 30_000 });
  expect(r.signal, `_check_${name} was ended at the suite's 30 s bound`).toBeNull();
  return { code: r.status ?? -1, out: r.stdout ?? '', err: r.stderr ?? '', ms: Date.now() - t0 };
}
const asked = (h: string): string[] => {
  const p = join(h, 'svc-asked');
  return fs.existsSync(p) ? fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean) : [];
};

    expect(lines[213]).toBe('  models codex docs history docs-sw model-advance-held-back model-held-behind '
      + 'model-sessions-behind model-advance-blocked   # nine entries on one line: every line below is cited by number elsewhere');
    const fns = lines.map((l) => /^_check_([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\(\) \{$/.exec(l)?.[1]).filter((n): n is string => n !== undefined);
    expect(fns.slice(-4)).toEqual([...CHECKS]);
  });

  it('the doctor reaches models-op only through advance-health, a read-only op, with the lock path from _models_lock_path and the registry from $_SVC_REG', () => {
    const code = fs.readFileSync(join(REPO, 'ccd', 'ccrc-doctor-checks'), 'utf8').split('\n')
      .filter((l) => !l.trim().startsWith('#')).join('\n');

    const op = fs.readFileSync(join(REPO, 'deploy', 'models-op.mjs'), 'utf8');

describe('model-advance-held-back', () => {
  it('WARNs a class whose failed advance stands, with its exact line and one remedy, and PASSes once an advance succeeds', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { advance: stepAdvance({ opus: { history: [failed()] } }) });
    const r = check(h, 'model-advance-held-back');
    expect(r.out).toBe('WARN model-advance-held-back: lane-a opus stays on model-5.6-gamma: model-6.1-gamma failed its '
      + 'canary 3 times since 2026-10-22T10:05Z (http 500: upstream error)\n'
      + '  remedy: the next hourly refresh retries it; \'ccrc models lane-a show\' shows the class, and '
      + '\'ccrc models lane-a hold opus\' stops the retries\n');
    expect(r.code).toBe(2);
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: stepAdvance({ opus: {
      previous: { model: 'model-5.6-gamma', effort: 'max' }, history: [failed(), { ...MOVE, at: '2026-10-22T13:05:10Z' }] } }) });
    const p = check(h, 'model-advance-held-back');
    expect(p.out).toBe('PASS model-advance-held-back: 1 lane(s) with a model registry: no class is held back by a '
      + 'failed canary or move\n');
    expect(p.code).toBe(0);
  });

  it('says "once" for one try, and names a move that failed after its canary passed', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { advance: stepAdvance({ opus: { history: [failed({ canary: 'passed', tries: 1, reason: 'materialise: EISDIR' })] } }) });
    expect(check(h, 'model-advance-held-back').out.split('\n')[0]).toBe('WARN model-advance-held-back: lane-a opus stays on '
      + 'model-5.6-gamma: moving to model-6.1-gamma failed once, at 2026-10-22T10:05Z (materialise: EISDIR)');
  });

  it('two classes of one lane share one line, and one remedy naming both', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, {
      registry: { ...STEP_REGISTRY, classes: { ...STEP_REGISTRY.classes, haiku: 'model-5.6-alpha' } },
      advance: stepAdvance({ haiku: { history: [failed({ from: 'model-5.6-alpha', to: 'model-6-alpha', tries: 1 })] },
        opus: { history: [failed()] } }),
    });
    const r = check(h, 'model-advance-held-back');
    expect(r.out).toBe('WARN model-advance-held-back: lane-a haiku stays on model-5.6-alpha: model-6-alpha failed its '
      + 'canary once, at 2026-10-22T10:05Z (http 500: upstream error); lane-a opus stays on model-5.6-gamma: '
      + 'model-6.1-gamma failed its canary 3 times since 2026-10-22T10:05Z (http 500: upstream error)\n'
      + '  remedy: the next hourly refresh retries each; \'ccrc models lane-a show\' shows the classes, and '
      + '\'ccrc models lane-a hold <class>\' stops a class\'s retries (haiku, opus)\n');
  });

  it('two lanes give two WARN lines, each with its own remedy', () => {
    const h = box({ laneB: true });
    plantLane(h, { advance: stepAdvance({ opus: { history: [failed()] } }) });
    plantLane(h, { id: 'lane-b', advance: stepAdvance({ opus: { history: [failed()] } }) });
    const lines = check(h, 'model-advance-held-back').out.split('\n').filter(Boolean);
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(lines[0]).toMatch(/^WARN model-advance-held-back: lane-a opus stays on model-5\.6-gamma: /);
    expect(lines[1]).toMatch(/^ {2}remedy: the next hourly refresh retries it; .*'ccrc models lane-a hold opus'/);
    expect(lines[2]).toMatch(/^WARN model-advance-held-back: lane-b opus stays on model-5\.6-gamma: /);
    expect(lines[3]).toMatch(/^ {2}remedy: the next hourly refresh retries it; .*'ccrc models lane-b hold opus'/);
  });

  it('a held class is not held back: it is model-held-behind\'s (D-5221)', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { advance: stepAdvance({ opus: { hold: HOLD, history: [failed()] } }) });
    expect(check(h, 'model-advance-held-back').out).toMatch(/^PASS model-advance-held-back: /);
    expect(check(h, 'model-held-behind').out).toMatch(/^WARN model-held-behind: lane-a opus is held /);
  });
});

describe('model-sessions-behind', () => {
  const RELAUNCH = '  remedy: a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself: once it is idle, relaunch it '
    + 'with \'ccd stop lane-a-demo\' then \'ccd start lane-a-demo\'; it resumes its conversation, and one with no class '
    + 'in its routing record may come back on its old model';
  const BEHIND_DEMO = 'WARN model-sessions-behind: lane-a session lane-a-demo last replied on model-5.6-gamma at '
    + '2026-10-22T09:12Z, in a turn begun 09:11Z, 42 h after opus moved to model-6.1-gamma';

  it('WARNs a running session still on the replaced model, naming the evidence, and PASSes once it renders the new one', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h);
    const r = check(h, 'model-sessions-behind');
    expect(r.out).toBe(`${BEHIND_DEMO}\n${RELAUNCH}\n`);
    expect(r.code).toBe(2);
    plantSession(h, { model: 'model-6.1-gamma' });
    expect(check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out).toBe('PASS model-sessions-behind: 1 lane(s) with a model registry: no '
      + 'running session is still on a model a move replaced 24 h or more ago\n');
  });

  it('asks the service manager only about the sessions the op listed, and nothing when it listed none', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h, { sid: 'lane-a-new', model: 'model-6.1-gamma' });
    check(h, 'model-sessions-behind');
    expect(asked(h)).toEqual([]);
    plantSession(h);
    check(h, 'model-sessions-behind');
    expect(asked(h)).toEqual(['claude-session@lane-a-demo.service']);
  });

  it('two running sessions behind on one lane share one line, and one remedy naming both', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h);
    plantSession(h, { sid: 'lane-a-two' });
    const lines = check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out.split('\n').filter(Boolean);
    expect(lines).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(lines[0]).toContain('lane-a session lane-a-demo last replied on model-5.6-gamma');
    expect(lines[0]).toContain('; lane-a session lane-a-two last replied on model-5.6-gamma');
    expect(lines[1]).toBe('  remedy: a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself: once each is idle, '
      + 'relaunch it with \'ccd stop <id>\' then \'ccd start <id>\' (lane-a-demo, lane-a-two); each resumes its '
      + 'conversation, and one with no class in its routing record may come back on its old model');
  });

  it.each([
    ['not running', 'inactive', '; 1 listed session(s) not running'],
    ['not reported by the service manager', null, '; 1 listed session(s) whose state the service manager did not report'],
  ] as [string, string | null, string][])('a listed session %s does not WARN, and the PASS counts it', (_w, svc, tail) => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h, { svc });
    expect(check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out).toBe('PASS model-sessions-behind: 1 lane(s) with a model registry: no '
      + `running session is still on a model a move replaced 24 h or more ago${tail}\n`);
  });

  it('the PASS names the sessions it could not measure, by why: a PASS never stands over sessions nobody read', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h, { sidecar: false });
    expect(spawnSync('mkfifo', [join(h, '.cc-sessions', 'lane-a-x.wrapper')]).status).toBe(0);
    expect(check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out).toBe('PASS model-sessions-behind: 1 lane(s) with a model registry: no '
      + 'running session is still on a model a move replaced 24 h or more ago; 2 session(s) could not be measured '
      + '(sidecar-absent 1, wrapper-unreadable 1)\n');
    expect(asked(h)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('a WARN line carries the same box-wide counts: sessions not running and sessions not measured are never dropped', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h);
    plantSession(h, { sid: 'lane-a-two', svc: 'inactive' });
    plantSession(h, { sid: 'lane-a-new', sidecar: false });
    expect(check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out).toBe(`${BEHIND_DEMO}; 1 listed session(s) not running; 1 session(s) `
      + `could not be measured (sidecar-absent 1)\n${RELAUNCH}\n`);
  });

  it('the remedy says a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself, and names the relaunch ccd has (D-5223)', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    plantSession(h);
    expect(check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out.split('\n')[1]).toBe(RELAUNCH);
    const ccd = fs.readFileSync(join(REPO, 'ccd', 'ccd'), 'utf8');
    expect(ccd).toMatch(/^ {2}stop\)\s+shift; cmd_stop "\$@" ;;$/m);
    expect(ccd).toMatch(/^ {2}start\)\s+shift; cmd_start "\$@" ;;$/m);
    expect(ccd).not.toMatch(/^ {2}restart\)/m);
  });

  it('SKIPs when the session registry is absent, and when it cannot be listed', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: MOVED_REGISTRY, advance: MOVED_ADVANCE });
    const reg = join(h, '.cc-sessions');
    const a = check(h, 'model-sessions-behind');
    expect(a.out).toBe(`SKIP model-sessions-behind: no session registry at ${reg}, so there is no running session to measure\n`);
    expect(a.code).toBe(3);
    fs.writeFileSync(reg, 'not a directory\n');
    expect(check(h, 'model-sessions-behind').out).toBe(`SKIP model-sessions-behind: the session registry at ${reg} could not `
      + 'be listed, so no session was measured\n');
  });
});

describe('model-advance-blocked', () => {
  it('WARNs each lane with its causes and one remedy clause per cause, and PASSes once they are gone', () => {
    const h = box();

      + '<vendor>-<version>-<family>); lane-a opus: pin-grammar (model-x-gamma is not <vendor>-<version>-<family>)\n'
      + '  remedy: per cause: pin — \'ccrc models lane-a set-class <class> <modelId>\'\n'
      + 'WARN model-advance-blocked: lane-b: lane-not-codex-kind (its roster row is exec.kind "external", and only an '
      + 'exec.kind "codex" lane advances)\n'
      + '  remedy: per cause: lane kind — make its roster row exec.kind "codex" (README, "A ChatGPT/Codex lane"), or '
      + 'leave it, and it never advances\n');
    expect(r.code).toBe(2);
    plantLane(h);
    plantLane(h, { id: 'lane-b', registry: null, catalogue: null, advance: null });
    expect(check(h, 'model-advance-blocked').out).toBe('PASS model-advance-blocked: 1 lane(s) with a model registry: '
      + 'nothing blocks an advance\n');
  });

  it('names a lock path that is a FIFO without opening it, beside a class\'s cause, with a clause for each (D-5193)', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { registry: { ...STEP_REGISTRY, classes: { ...STEP_REGISTRY.classes, opus: 'model-x-gamma' } } });
    const locks = join(h, '.ccrc', 'locks');
    fs.mkdirSync(locks, { mode: 0o700 });
    const fifo = join(locks, 'models-lane-a.lock');
    expect(spawnSync('mkfifo', [fifo]).status).toBe(0);
    const r = check(h, 'model-advance-blocked');
    expect(r.out).toBe(`WARN model-advance-blocked: lane-a: lock-unwritable (${fifo} is not a regular file (a FIFO, a `
      + 'directory or a socket), which the lane-files lock never opens); lane-a opus: pin-grammar (model-x-gamma is not '
      + '<vendor>-<version>-<family>)\n'
      + '  remedy: per cause: lock — at the path the finding names: remove a symlink, a FIFO, or whatever stands where '
      + 'the lock file or its directory belongs; make a lock file this account cannot write writable, or remove it; '
      + 'give a lock directory another account owns back to this account; a lock directory this account owns is made '
      + '0700 by the next writer (\'chmod 700\' clears this now); pin — \'ccrc models lane-a set-class <class> '
      + '<modelId>\'\n');
    expect(fs.lstatSync(fifo).isFIFO()).toBe(true);
  });

  it('the advance-file clause never says rm, and warns that a removed file refills an emptied class', () => {
    const h = box();
    plantLane(h, { advance: null });
    fs.mkdirSync(join(h, '.ccrc', 'models', 'lane-a.advance.json'));
    expect(check(h, 'model-advance-blocked').out.split('\n')[1]).toBe('  remedy: per cause: advance file — repair the '
      + 'file the finding names; if you remove it instead, its holds and move history are lost and the next hourly '
      + 'refresh seeds every empty class again and fills it, so run \'ccrc models lane-a hold <class>\' at once for '
      + 'each class that must stay where it is');
  });
});

    expect(r.code).toBe(3);
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The table line and the four checks**

In `ccd/ccrc-doctor-checks`, replace the line (in place, so no line below it moves):

```bash
  models codex docs history docs-sw   # five entries on one line: every line below is cited by number elsewhere
```

with:

```bash
  models codex docs history docs-sw model-advance-held-back model-held-behind model-sessions-behind model-advance-blocked   # nine entries on one line: every line below is cited by number elsewhere
```

Append at the end of `ccd/ccrc-doctor-checks`, after `_check_docs-sw`'s closing `}`:

```bash

# ── model-advance-held-back, model-held-behind, model-sessions-behind, model-advance-blocked ──
# (auto-advance spec §2.8; plan W3 Task 15). APPENDED HERE, with their four names on `models`' table line, for
# `_check_timeout`'s reason: lines in this file are cited by number from `ccrc`, the tests and the docs, and a
# function inserted mid-file would move every one of them.
#
# WHAT THEY READ: one answer, `deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health` (plan W3 Task 14), which each check asks once
# (`cmd_doctor` runs every check in its own `$( … )`, so nothing one check sets survives to the next). It is
# box-wide and READ-ONLY: it reads each lane's model files, the session registry and each lane-files lock path,
# and it writes nothing, takes no lock and never opens a lock path. Two paths reach it from here and are never
# spelled twice (D-5219): the session registry as `$_SVC_REG`, and the lock path as
# `_models_lock_path '{id}'`, whose `{id}` the op fills per lane. `_plat_timeout` runs a program, never a shell
# function, so node is spelled here as `_models_node_locked` spells it; its bound is `CCRC_DOCTOR_GH_TIMEOUT` (15 s
# by default), the knob `_check_history` already puts on its own node read (D-5224).
#
# WHAT EACH SAYS: one WARN line per lane, its findings joined with `_dr_join`, then that lane's remedy; a PASS that
# names how many lanes were measured. Class words come from the answer; this block spells none.
#  - `model-advance-held-back`: a class whose newest history entry is a failed advance to its standing candidate
#    (its canary failed, or the move after a passed canary did). Clears when an advance succeeds, when the candidate
#    leaves (D-5191), or when the class is held (D-5221: a hold stops
#    the retries, and the class is then `model-held-behind`'s).
#  - `model-held-behind`: a held class with a newer eligible model in its family, or whose pin has left the
#    catalogue (the op's `reason: retired`: its fallback may be OLDER, so that line never calls it newer). Clears
#    when the hold is released.
#  - `model-sessions-behind`: a RUNNING session still rendering a model some move replaced a day or more ago, in a
#    turn begun after that move; the line names that evidence (D-5194). The op lists
#    sessions from their files alone; this check asks `_svc_is_active` about each LISTED session only, and only one
#    the manager reports running WARNs. A running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself (measured by
#    the auto-advance plan's Task 1), so after a real advance this WARNs until the session is relaunched; the remedy
#    names the relaunch ccd has, `ccd stop <id>` then `ccd start <id>`, once the session is idle (a stop ends the
#    pane, and a turn in flight with it), and says a session with no class in its routing record may come back on
#    its old model (D-5223). Its PASS line and every WARN line carry the same box-wide
#    tail: the listed sessions not running, those whose state the manager did not report, and the sessions the op
#    could not measure, by why (D-5220), so no verdict stands over sessions nobody
#    read (D-4052's rule for `_dr_cx_sessions`).
#  - `model-advance-blocked`: a lane or class that cannot advance, with its cause word (`BLOCKED_CAUSES`,
#    `shared/model-advance.mjs`) and the op's detail; one remedy clause per cause (D-5225).
#
# SKIP, never a verdict nobody measured: on a `server`-role box (D-3111, read as every per-account check here reads
# it); with no jq; when the op printed no single answer object within the bound, or refused; when no lane has a model
# registry; and, for `model-sessions-behind` alone, when the session registry is absent or cannot be listed. WARN,
# never FAIL: `ccrc install` and `ccrc update` end with doctor, and nothing here is down. The one FAIL is the loaded
# guard, for a table sourced by something that is not ccrc.
#
# BUILTINS AND jq ONLY, with node for the op: the doctor suite's PATH holds no system directory (`_check_docs`' note),
# and no jq regular-expression function is used (a jq without Oniguruma has none; `_check_jq_regex`).

DR_MA_JSON=''
DR_MA_LANES=0
# jq's one shared definition: control characters out of a finding, so a detail can never split its row or its line.
DR_MA_JQ_DEFS='def clean: explode | map(if . < 32 or . == 127 then 32 else . end) | implode; '

# The one read each check starts with: the loaded guard, the server-role SKIP, the bounded op and the answer's own
# shape. rc 0 with DR_MA_JSON (the answer) and DR_MA_LANES (how many lanes it names); any other rc is the verdict the
# calling check returns, already printed.
_dr_ma_read() {   # <check name>
  local name="$1" fn role="" out rc lt err
  DR_MA_JSON=''; DR_MA_LANES=0
  for fn in _box_env_value _plat_timeout _svc_is_active _models_roster_path _models_lock_path; do
    if ! declare -F "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -z "${CCRC_HERE:-}" ] || [ -z "${_SVC_REG:-}" ]; then
      _dr_fail "$name" "ccrc's own library is not loaded ($fn, CCRC_HERE or _SVC_REG is missing), so no lane's advance state was read" \
        "this is a bug in ccrc, not a fact about your box — the model-advance checks call functions declared in ccrc itself, and this check table was sourced by something that is not ccrc"
      return 1
    fi
  done
  # -f BEFORE -r: `_check_skills`' guard order, for its reason (a directory answers -r too).
  [ -f "${BOX_ENV_FILE:-}" ] && [ -r "${BOX_ENV_FILE:-}" ] && role="$(_box_env_value "$BOX_ENV_FILE" CCRC_ROLE)"
  if [ "$role" = server ]; then
    _dr_skip "$name" "this box records CCRC_ROLE=server, so it runs no lane and keeps no model class"
    return 3
  fi
  if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    _dr_skip "$name" "jq is not on PATH, so deploy/models-op.mjs's advance-health answer could not be read — the 'jq' check above owns that"
    return 3
  fi
  lt="$(_models_lock_path '{id}')"
  out="$(_plat_timeout "$CCRC_DOCTOR_GH_TIMEOUT" node "$CCRC_HERE/../deploy/models-op.mjs" advance-health \
    --file "$(_models_roster_path)" --reg "$_SVC_REG" --lock-template "$lt" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)"; rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -eq 124 ]; then
    _dr_skip "$name" "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health gave no answer within ${CCRC_DOCTOR_GH_TIMEOUT}s, so no lane's advance state was read"
    return 3
  fi
  if ! printf '%s' "$out" | jq -e -s 'length == 1 and (.[0] | type) == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    _dr_skip "$name" "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health printed no answer (exit $rc), so no lane's advance state was read"
    return 3
  fi
  if ! printf '%s' "$out" | jq -e '.ok == true' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    err="$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '.error // "no word" | tostring' 2>/dev/null)"
    _dr_skip "$name" "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health refused ($err), so no lane's advance state was read — the 'models' check above owns the roster"
    return 3
  fi
  if ! printf '%s' "$out" | jq -e '.op == "advance-health" and (.now | type) == "string" and (.sessions | type) == "string" and (.lanes | type) == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    _dr_skip "$name" "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health answered in a shape this check does not read, so no lane's advance state was read"
    return 3
  fi
  DR_MA_LANES="$(printf '%s' "$out" | jq -r '.lanes | length' 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ "$DR_MA_LANES" = 0 ]; then
    _dr_skip "$name" "no lane on this box has a model registry, so no class can advance"
    return 3
  fi
  DR_MA_JSON="$out"
  return 0
}

# Words joined with ", ", for a remedy that names several classes or sessions.
_dr_ma_list() { local out="" x; for x in "$@"; do out+="${out:+, }$x"; done; printf '%s' "$out"; }

# One WARN line per lane from ROWS (`<lane>\x1f<key>\x1f<finding>` per line, a lane's rows together, as jq emits
# them): the lane's findings joined with `_dr_join`, then <tail>, then `<remedy fn> <lane> <key>…`'s remedy. PASS
# with <pass detail><tail> when ROWS holds none. <tail> (empty, or `; …` clauses) is box-wide, so it rides EVERY
# verdict line the check prints and is never dropped because some lane WARNed. Returns the check's rc.
_dr_ma_report() {   # <check name> <rows> <remedy fn> <pass detail> [<tail>]
  local name="$1" rows="$2" fix="$3" pass="$4" tail="${5:-}" lane="" id key text rc=0
  local -a texts=() keys=()
  while IFS=$'\x1f' read -r id key text; do
    [ -n "$id" ] || continue
    if [ -n "$lane" ] && [ "$id" != "$lane" ]; then
      _dr_warn "$name" "$(_dr_join "${texts[@]}")$tail" "$("$fix" "$lane" "${keys[@]}")"; rc=2
      texts=(); keys=()
    fi
    lane="$id"; texts+=("$text"); keys+=("$key")
  done <<< "$rows"
  if [ -n "$lane" ]; then _dr_warn "$name" "$(_dr_join "${texts[@]}")$tail" "$("$fix" "$lane" "${keys[@]}")"; rc=2; fi
  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || _dr_pass "$name" "$pass$tail"
  return "$rc"
}

_dr_ma_held_back_fix() {   # <lane> <class>…
  local id="$1"; shift
  if [ "$#" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '%s' "the next hourly refresh retries it; 'ccrc models $id show' shows the class, and 'ccrc models $id hold $1' stops the retries"
  else
    printf '%s' "the next hourly refresh retries each; 'ccrc models $id show' shows the classes, and 'ccrc models $id hold <class>' stops a class's retries ($(_dr_ma_list "$@"))"
  fi
}

_dr_ma_held_behind_fix() {   # <lane> <class>…
  local id="$1"; shift
  if [ "$#" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '%s' "'ccrc models $id release $1' lets the next hourly refresh advance it, canary first"
  else
    printf '%s' "'ccrc models $id release <class>' lets the next hourly refresh advance that class, canary first ($(_dr_ma_list "$@"))"
  fi
}

# "Once it is idle": `ccd stop` ends the pane (`cmd_stop`'s `tmux kill-session`), and a turn in flight with it. The
# relaunch resumes the conversation; a respawn carries `--model <class>` only when the session's routing record holds
# a class (`ccd/ccd`'s `routeflags`), so one without may come back on its old model (spec §2.5 item 5).
_dr_ma_sessions_fix() {   # <lane> <session>…
  shift
  if [ "$#" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '%s' "a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself: once it is idle, relaunch it with 'ccd stop $1' then 'ccd start $1'; it resumes its conversation, and one with no class in its routing record may come back on its old model"
  else
    printf '%s' "a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself: once each is idle, relaunch it with 'ccd stop <id>' then 'ccd start <id>' ($(_dr_ma_list "$@")); each resumes its conversation, and one with no class in its routing record may come back on its old model"
  fi
}

# One clause per cause, in the order the lane's findings name them; two words with one remedy (an advance file
# unreadable or invalid, say) share one clause (D-5225). The advance file's clause never
# says `rm`: `ccrc models <id> rm` reaps the registry too, and would reset every pin for a file only the holds and
# history live in. Nor does it offer removal as harmless: a fresh file comes from the backfill, which seeds every
# EMPTY class's family again (W1), so the next hourly refresh would fill a class the operator emptied by hand
# (D-5195) unless it is held first. The lock clause covers every shape `lock-unwritable`
# names, including the RC7-letter one (a directory this account owns but cannot write), which the next writer's
# `chmod 700` repairs by itself.
_dr_ma_blocked_fix() {   # <lane> <cause>…
  local id="$1" c part head seen="|" out=""; shift
  for c in "$@"; do
    case "$c" in
      advance-file-unreadable|advance-file-invalid)
        part="advance file — repair the file the finding names; if you remove it instead, its holds and move history are lost and the next hourly refresh seeds every empty class again and fills it, so run 'ccrc models $id hold <class>' at once for each class that must stay where it is" ;;
      registry-unreadable|registry-invalid)
        part="registry — repair the file the finding names, or 'ccrc models $id rm' then 'ccrc models $id init <probe>'" ;;
      catalogue-unreadable|catalogue-invalid)
        part="catalogue — 'ccrc models refresh $id'" ;;
      windows-unreadable)
        part="windows file — repair or remove the file the finding names" ;;
      pin-grammar)
        part="pin — 'ccrc models $id set-class <class> <modelId>'" ;;
      shared-family)
        part="shared family — 'ccrc models $id set-class <class> <modelId>' on one of the classes named, or 'ccrc models $id hold <class>'" ;;
      lane-not-codex-kind)
        part="lane kind — make its roster row exec.kind \"codex\" (README, \"A ChatGPT/Codex lane\"), or leave it, and it never advances" ;;
      lock-unwritable)
        part="lock — at the path the finding names: remove a symlink, a FIFO, or whatever stands where the lock file or its directory belongs; make a lock file this account cannot write writable, or remove it; give a lock directory another account owns back to this account; a lock directory this account owns is made 0700 by the next writer ('chmod 700' clears this now)" ;;
      *)
        part="$c — see the finding" ;;
    esac
    head="${part%% — *}"
    case "$seen" in *"|$head|"*) continue ;; esac
    seen+="$head|"
    out+="${out:+; }$part"
  done
  printf '%s' "per cause: $out"
}

_check_model-advance-held-back() {
  local rc rows
  _dr_ma_read model-advance-held-back; rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || return "$rc"
  if ! rows="$(printf '%s' "$DR_MA_JSON" | jq -r "$DR_MA_JQ_DEFS"'
      .lanes[] | .id as $id | .heldBack[]
      | [$id, .class,
         ("\($id) \(.class) stays on \(.from // "none"): "
          + (if .canary == "passed" then "moving to \(.to) failed" else "\(.to) failed its canary" end)
          + (if (.tries // 1) > 1 then " \(.tries) times since \(.since[0:16])Z" else " once, at \(.since[0:16])Z" end)
          + (if (.reason // "") != "" then " (\(.reason))" else "" end) | clean)]
      | join("\u001f")' 2>/dev/null)"; then
    _dr_skip model-advance-held-back "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health answered in a shape this check does not read, so no lane's advance state was read"
    return 3
  fi
  _dr_ma_report model-advance-held-back "$rows" _dr_ma_held_back_fix \
    "$DR_MA_LANES lane(s) with a model registry: no class is held back by a failed canary or move"
}

_check_model-held-behind() {
  local rc rows
  _dr_ma_read model-held-behind; rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || return "$rc"
  if ! rows="$(printf '%s' "$DR_MA_JSON" | jq -r "$DR_MA_JQ_DEFS"'
      .lanes[] | .id as $id | .heldBehind[]
      | [$id, .class,
         ("\($id) \(.class) is held (\(.hold.at[0:16])Z, by \(.hold.by)) "
          + (if .reason == "retired"
             then "on \(.pin), which has left the catalogue; \(.newer) is the newest left in its family"
             else "while \(.newer) is newer in its family" end) | clean)]
      | join("\u001f")' 2>/dev/null)"; then
    _dr_skip model-held-behind "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health answered in a shape this check does not read, so no lane's advance state was read"
    return 3
  fi
  _dr_ma_report model-held-behind "$rows" _dr_ma_held_behind_fix \
    "$DR_MA_LANES lane(s) with a model registry: no held class has a newer model in its family"
}

_check_model-sessions-behind() {
  local rc rows state live="" id sid text w dead=0 unasked=0 unmeasured tail=""
  _dr_ma_read model-sessions-behind; rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || return "$rc"
  state="$(printf '%s' "$DR_MA_JSON" | jq -r '.sessions' 2>/dev/null)"
  case "$state" in
    read) ;;
    absent)
      _dr_skip model-sessions-behind "no session registry at $_SVC_REG, so there is no running session to measure"
      return 3 ;;
    *)
      _dr_skip model-sessions-behind "the session registry at $_SVC_REG could not be listed, so no session was measured"
      return 3 ;;
  esac
  if ! rows="$(printf '%s' "$DR_MA_JSON" | jq -r "$DR_MA_JQ_DEFS"'
      (.now | fromdateiso8601) as $now
      | .lanes[] | .id as $id | .sessionsBehind[]
      | [$id, .session,
         ("\($id) session \(.session) last replied on \(.from) at \(.renderAt[0:16])Z, in a turn begun \(.turnAt[11:16])Z, "
          + "\((($now - (.movedAt | fromdateiso8601)) / 3600) | floor) h after \(.class) moved to \(.to // "none")" | clean)]
      | join("\u001f")' 2>/dev/null)"; then
    _dr_skip model-sessions-behind "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health answered in a shape this check does not read, so no session was measured"
    return 3
  fi
  # The sessions the op could not measure, box-wide and by why: a `.wrapper` it could not read (no known lane), and
  # each lane's own. Nothing when there are none (`select` emits no line); an answer without either list is a shape
  # this check does not read (jq exits 5 iterating null), so it SKIPs rather than PASS over sessions it cannot count.
  if ! unmeasured="$(printf '%s' "$DR_MA_JSON" | jq -r "$DR_MA_JQ_DEFS"'
      [.sessionsUnmeasured[], (.lanes[] | .sessionsUnmeasured[])]
      | select(length > 0)
      | ("\(length) session(s) could not be measured ("
         + (group_by(.why) | map("\(.[0].why) \(length)") | join(", ")) + ")" | clean)' 2>/dev/null)"; then
    _dr_skip model-sessions-behind "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health answered in a shape this check does not read, so no session was measured"
    return 3
  fi
  # The service manager is asked about each LISTED session only, and only one it reports running WARNs: a session
  # that is not running, or whose state it did not report, is counted in the tail instead.
  while IFS=$'\x1f' read -r id sid text; do
    [ -n "$id" ] || continue
    w="$(_svc_is_active "claude-session@$sid.service" </dev/null)"
    case "$w" in
      active|activating|reloading|refreshing|deactivating) live+="$id"$'\x1f'"$sid"$'\x1f'"$text"$'\n' ;;
      '') unasked=$((unasked + 1)) ;;
      *) dead=$((dead + 1)) ;;
    esac
  done <<< "$rows"
  [ "$dead" -eq 0 ] || tail+="; $dead listed session(s) not running"
  [ "$unasked" -eq 0 ] || tail+="; $unasked listed session(s) whose state the service manager did not report"
  [ -z "$unmeasured" ] || tail+="; $unmeasured"
  _dr_ma_report model-sessions-behind "$live" _dr_ma_sessions_fix \
    "$DR_MA_LANES lane(s) with a model registry: no running session is still on a model a move replaced 24 h or more ago" \
    "$tail"
}

_check_model-advance-blocked() {
  local rc rows
  _dr_ma_read model-advance-blocked; rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || return "$rc"
  if ! rows="$(printf '%s' "$DR_MA_JSON" | jq -r "$DR_MA_JQ_DEFS"'
      .lanes[] | .id as $id | .blocked[]
      | [$id, .cause,
         ((if .class == null then $id else "\($id) \(.class)" end) + ": \(.cause) (\(.detail))" | clean)]
      | join("\u001f")' 2>/dev/null)"; then
    _dr_skip model-advance-blocked "deploy/models-op.mjs advance-health answered in a shape this check does not read, so no lane's advance state was read"
    return 3
  fi
  _dr_ma_report model-advance-blocked "$rows" _dr_ma_blocked_fix \
    "$DR_MA_LANES lane(s) with a model registry: nothing blocks an advance"
}
```

### W3 deviations beyond the skeleton

The skeleton's seventeen deviations, and the slugs W1 and W2 added, stand as written (ruling RB1). This wave adds seven
more, each by its slug until the allocator issues a number; each is stated in the task where it first appears. One
skeleton slug is issued with a wider text.

| Slug | Where | Deviation, and why |
|---|---|---|
| D-5219 | Tasks 14, 15 | `advance-health` takes `--reg` (the session registry) and `--lock-template` (the lane-files lock path with `{id}` in place of the lane) from its bash caller, both required; skeleton §3.5 gives it `--file` only. `ccd/ccrc` spells the session registry once (`_SVC_REG`) and the lock path once (`_models_lock_path`, pinned by `single-definition.test.ts`), so node takes both rather than spelling a second copy |
| D-5220 | Tasks 14, 15 | The answer carries fields §3.9 does not show: `canary` on each `heldBack` entry, so the WARN says whether the canary or the move failed, as §3.8's two push messages do; `reason` on each `heldBehind` entry (`chooseCandidate`'s `newer`, `retired` or `empty`), so a held class whose pin left the catalogue is not called "behind a newer model" when its fallback may be older; a top-level `sessions` word (`read`, `absent`, `unreadable`), so a session registry that cannot be listed is a SKIP of `model-sessions-behind`, never a PASS that measured nothing; and `sessionsUnmeasured`, at the top level for a session whose `.wrapper` cannot be read (`wrapper-unreadable`) and on each lane for a session of it that could not be judged (`advance-file-unreadable`, `marker-absent`, `marker-unreadable`, `sidecar-absent`, `sidecar-unreadable`), which `model-sessions-behind` counts by why on its PASS line and every WARN line, so no verdict stands over sessions nobody read (D-4052's rule for the `codex` check). Under ruling RC1 this check is the only backstop, and a lane whose homes write no sidecar would otherwise PASS without one session measured |
| D-5221 | Tasks 14, 15 | A held class is never `model-advance-held-back`; with a newer model it is `model-held-behind`. Spec §2.8 clears held-back only when an advance succeeds, but a hold stops the hourly retries (§3.9's own remedy says so), so held-back's "the next hourly refresh retries it" would be false and the class would WARN twice |
| D-5222 | Task 14 | `sessionBehind` judges, per class, the newest SUCCESSFUL history entry whose `from` is the session's model, not only the class's newest move (§3.9's "the lane's newest ok move M"). With only the newest move, a session two moves behind would never be reported once a second move followed within a day: the backstop would go quiet |
| D-5223 | Task 15 | `model-sessions-behind`'s remedy names `ccd stop <id>` then `ccd start <id>`, the relaunch ccd has, to run once the session is idle (`cmd_stop` kills the pane, and a turn in flight with it), and says a running session does not always pick up a re-pin by itself (ruling RC1). It promises no pins: the one-argument `start` resumes the conversation, but a respawn carries `--model <class>` only when the routing record holds a class, so a session with none may come back on its old model (spec §2.5 item 5), and the remedy says so. §3.9's `'ccd restart <id>'` names a verb ccd does not have, and its "should move at its next turn" is the D11 claim Task 1 measured false. The PWA's "Restart session" adopts a running pane and relaunches nothing, so the remedy names the shell pair alone |
| D-5224 | Task 15 | Each check bounds its one `advance-health` run by `CCRC_DOCTOR_GH_TIMEOUT` (15 s by default), the knob `_check_history` already reuses for its own node read, and spells the command as node's own. §3.9's `_plat_timeout 20 _models_node …` cannot run: `_plat_timeout` runs a program, never a shell function. A new knob would also have to join every suite's knob-deletion array |
| D-5225 | Task 15 | `model-advance-blocked`'s remedy has one clause per cause the lane's findings name (eight clauses, two of them shared by two words), not §3.9's one sentence. That sentence sends an unreadable advance file to `ccrc models <id> rm` then `init codex`, which reaps the registry too and resets every pin; the advance-file clause says to repair that file alone, and that removing it instead loses its holds and history and lets the next hourly refresh seed and fill every empty class again (a fresh file comes from the backfill), so each class that must stay put is held at once (Review Focus line 3, D-5195). The lock clause names every shape `lock-unwritable` reports, the RC7-letter one included |

Issued wider: **D-5193** also names `lock-unwritable` (ruling RC7): `advance-health` reports a lane
whose lock path is a symlink or anything but a regular file this account can write, or whose lock directory is a
symlink, not a directory, another account's (lstat's `uid`, the case where `access` says writable but W1's
`chmod 700` fails), or not writable, measured with `lstat` and `access(W_OK)` only; an absent directory or file is no
finding. Each of these is a shape every writer on the lane is refused, except one reported by RC7's letter: a
directory this account owns but cannot write, which the next writer's `chmod 700` repairs (its remedy says so). It
closes the gap W2's D-5209 left to this wave.

## Wave W4: op, route, panel, labels

### Wave contract

- **What it delivers.** The agent's `models` op, the third wire-triggered spawn outside the exec whitelist (Task 16
  declares its words, guards, argv and bounds in `shared/agent-protocol.ts`; Task 17 builds the agent's port, gate and
  case); `labels` on every `describe` answer, the `ModelsLaneView` reader and the roster's `laneKind` (Task 18); the
  session-gated `GET` and `POST /api/models/:lane` with a 60 s per-lane cache (Task 19); the PWA's per-lane Models
  sheet, opened from each Codex lane's row on the Accounts screen (Task 20); and picker labels from data, chosen by
  lane kind, with both wrapper-name literal branches gone from `pwa/src/lib/models.ts` (Task 21, D17's Codex half).
- **PR boundary.** One PR, on the workspace's own branch (never a separate feature branch), cut from `origin/main`
  after W2 has merged. It ends when a tap on Hold, release or Revert in the Models sheet reaches `ccrc models <lane>
  hold|release|revert <class>` on the fleet box through the agent and the sheet settles on the box's own answer, and
  a Codex lane's picker rows read the catalogue labels of its current pins.
- **Depends on.** W1 (the verbs `ccrc models <id> hold|release|revert <class>`, `describe()`'s `advance`, the advance
  file's `parseAdvance` and `lastMoveOf`, `familyOf`, the lane-files lock) and W2 Task 7 (`MODELS_LANE_ID_RE` and
  `MODELS_RESERVED_IDS` in `shared/models.mjs`, re-exported by `shared/models.ts`), which is why the branch is cut
  after W2 merges. It may run beside W3: the two touch disjoint arms of `deploy/models-op.mjs` (W3 adds the
  `advance-health` op row, W4 widens `describe`), and W4 reads nothing W3 adds. Under ruling RC8 the Models sheet
  shows no sessions-behind facts: `show` does not compute them, and this wave adds no probe of `~/.cc-sessions` on
  the agent path. Doctor's `model-sessions-behind` (W3) stays the one place they are named.
- **Effect on a live box.** None hourly: the refresh, the advance step and the class registry are untouched. Each box
  gains a new code path only when the PWA asks. The fleet node's agent answers one more op (`ready.ops` gains
  `models`). It spawns `~/.local/bin/ccrc models <lane> show` when the Models sheet opens, AND whenever a Codex lane's
  picker needs its labels: every `SessionScreen` of a session on a Codex lane and every New Session lane pick reads
  `GET /api/models/:lane` (Task 21). The server's 60 s cache makes that at most one `show` per lane per minute while
  the view is cached; a refusal is never cached, so each read of a lane the fleet box does not know spawns once. It
  spawns `… hold|release|revert <class>` on a tap, under the lane-files lock W1 put on every writing verb. One gate per
  agent process covers every action, so a tap that lands while a picker's read is running answers `429 busy`, and the
  sheet's toast says to try again in a moment. A revert from the phone moves a live class, exactly as the shell verb
  does. The server answers `GET` and `POST /api/models/:lane`, session-gated (behind the passkey when armed, open
  dark, as every PWA route is). `GET /api/accounts` gains `laneKind` on every roster row. In the PWA, each codex-kind
  lane's row gains a Models button, and a codex-kind lane's picker rows show its catalogue labels instead of
  hard-coded ones, so in remote mode the stale-label window W2's contract names closes. A running session is not moved
  by any of this: under D11's fallback a session may keep the model it has until it is relaunched, and the sheet's
  revert confirmation says so. Until both boxes run this build the sheet says which half is older
  (`agent-predates-op`, `verb-missing` or `server-predates-route`).
- **Local mode, the install default (`CCRC_FLEET=local`).** There is no agent, so both routes answer `501
  not-configured` (D-5203). On such a box the Models sheet says so, and a codex-kind lane's
  pickers read `<Class> class` with no model name: no row lights from the statusline, and a class write is never shown
  `queued`, because its readback is unmeasurable. Today those pickers show hard-coded names. That is the known limit of
  D-5203 until a local spawn port exists (Later); "W4 deviations beyond the skeleton" records it.
- **Before this wave reaches the fleet (a precondition, not a task).** Every Codex lane's roster row is `exec.kind:
  'codex'`. Before the rollout the coordinator measures it on the server box, read-only, from the roster: `jq -r
  '.accounts[] | select(.telemetry != "anthropic") | "\(.id) \(.exec.kind)"' ~/.ccrc/accounts.json` prints `codex`
  beside every Codex lane (the ids stay in the coordinator's notes, never in a commit or a PR). After the rollout,
  `GET /api/accounts` shows `laneKind: 'codex'` on each of them. A Codex lane still rostered `exec.kind: 'external'`
  reads `other` (`laneKindOf`, Task 18, whose mapping is pinned): its row gets no Models button, and its pickers fall
  back to the alias rows (Claude Code's own class names, ending in Default) and offer Ultracode, which has no meaning on
  its backend. That is worse than today's hard-coded rows on that lane. W2's advance already skips such a lane
  (D-5198), and W3's `model-advance-blocked` names it (`lane-not-codex-kind`). If one remains,
  the rollout waits until its row is flipped, unless the coordinator rules otherwise; this plan does not re-map it.
- **The record of a tap.** The server's `console.warn` audit line records every POST that reaches the op
  (D-5229); on the fleet box, the verb itself records a revert as a history entry
  (`how: 'revert'`) and a hold or release in the class's `hold`. Like the models push under ruling RC6, the POST gets
  no feed record and no rate cap of its own. A revert clears `previous`, so a second one answers `no-previous` until
  the next advance, and a hold or release moves no model.
- **Before the PR is marked ready.** Every command in "W4 whole-branch checks" is green, one file at a time, against
  the base lines measured in "Before Task 16"; every task's mutation rows are measured and recorded in its commit
  body; the PR's `select tests` summary lists `auth-gate.test.ts`, `box-token-census.test.ts`,
  `remote-connect.test.ts`, `update-inventory.test.ts`, `whitelist-subset.test.ts` and `accounts-route.test.ts` (or
  each was run here, alone); and every `D-TBD-<slug>` this wave wrote has been replaced by the number the allocator
  issued for it (`dtbd.test.ts` is red until then).
- **Deviation ids.** This wave writes the skeleton's `D-5203`, `D-5202`,
  `D-5190`, `D-5191` (cited by the view's `heldBack` docstring, Task 18)
  and `D-5198` where they apply, and five slugs beyond the skeleton, each stated in the task where
  it first appears and listed under "W4 deviations beyond the skeleton":
  `D-5226` (Task 16), `D-5227`
  (Task 17), `D-5228` (Task 18), `D-5229` (Task 19) and
  `D-5230` (Task 19).
  A worker never writes a number of its own; a departure found while executing is reported by a new slug.
- **The wave's notes.** Every measured mutation row is recorded in `.superpowers/sdd/auto-advance-w4/` at the
  worktree's top (gitignored; the fleet box's `/tmp` reaper removes anything older than 12 h, which a wave outlives).
  Shell variables do not survive from one command to the next, so every bash block below that uses `$SCRATCH` sets
  it itself, and every commit step refuses to run when its task's record is missing or empty: the commit body IS the
  mutation record the PR is checked against.

Line anchors below are at `a3cebde1b`. Stage 0, W1, W2 and (if it merged first) W3 move them, so every edit quotes
the text to find. Every test command runs cd'd into its package (`server/`, `agent/` or `pwa/`), in the foreground,
with a timeout of at least 600000 ms, one file per command. Never run a bare `npx vitest`. Every count in a mutation
row is a prediction: run each row on the shipped file, restore it, prove the restore with `git diff --exit-code --
<file>`, and record the row in the task's commit body as `<row> → <n> failed (<titles>)`.

**This repository is public.** Fixtures use `lane-a` and `lane-b` and neutral model ids such as `model-6.1-gamma`.
No lane, account, wrapper or host name, no real model id and no absolute home path is written into any file this
wave touches. Where an edit removes or replaces existing text that carries such a name, the text is identified by its
position and shape (for example, "the case directly above `it('offers the Ultracode rung on an Anthropic account\'s
Effort select'`"), never quoted.

**Review Focus, where this wave places its tests (ruling RB5):**
- Line 1, races and locks, W4's case: "a POST hold racing the hourly commit" is Task 19 Step 1's end-to-end describe
  (a real agent, the real `ccrc`, a real `flock` holder standing in for the commit): the hold waits the commit out and
  lands, and a commit that outlasts the lock's 20 s wait is a `409 lock-busy` well inside the 40 s spawn bound, never
  a `504` and never a child killed holding the lock. The bound order itself is Task 16's pin, and the one gate across
  connections is Task 17's.

```ts
// Auto-advance plan W4 Task 16 (spec 2026-10-13 §2.7, D14): the L0 words, guards, argv shapes and bounds both ends of
// the agent's `models` op agree on. Every name here is declared ONCE, in `shared/agent-protocol.ts`; the agent
// (`agent/src/server.ts`, `agent/src/modelsop.ts`) and the server's link (`server/src/models/link.ts`) import it.
// Neutral lane ids only (`lane-a`): this repository is public.
//
// What is pinned:
//  1. The two argv shapes, frozen, and a RangeError for everything else: the guards run again at the build, so an
//     edit that lets an unvalidated argument past `validateReq` still never reaches a spawn.
//  2. The lane guard: the models writer's own pattern, minus the two words `ccrc models` reads as box-wide
//     subcommands, so `..`, `/`, a leading `-`, an upper-case letter, a NUL and a 33rd character never reach an argv.
//  3. The bounds' ORDER: the lane-files lock's wait (read from `ccd/ccrc`: the child's three-name environment cannot
//     override it) < the spawn bound < spawn + grace + drain < the server's op timeout. So a verb that waits out a
//     writer refuses `lock-busy` by itself, the agent answers before the server gives up, and nothing kills a child
//     that holds the lane's lock because the lock was slow.
//  4. The closed vocabularies: seven error words, four actions, each with its one guard.
//  5. The actions are verbs `ccd/ccrc` really has, and the verb-missing line is the line its usage refusal prints.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import {
  MODELS_ACTIONS, MODELS_ANSWER_MAX_BYTES, MODELS_DRAIN_MS, MODELS_KILL_GRACE_MS, MODELS_OP, MODELS_OP_ERRORS,
  MODELS_OP_TIMEOUT_MS, MODELS_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS, MODELS_VERB_MISSING_LINE, TOKEN_SYNC_OP, UPDATE_OP,
  isModelsAction, isModelsClass, isModelsLaneId, isModelsOpError, isModelsVerbMissing, modelsSpawnArgv,
  type AgentReq,
} from '../../shared/agent-protocol.js';
import { CLASSES, MODELS_LANE_ID_RE, MODELS_RESERVED_IDS } from '../../shared/models.js';
import { ghContainedEnv } from './ccdWsHelpers.js';
import { mkTmp } from './tmpHelpers.js';

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = path.resolve(here, '..', '..');
const CCRC = path.join(REPO, 'ccd', 'ccrc');
const CCRC_TEXT = readFileSync(CCRC, 'utf8');
const WRITING = MODELS_ACTIONS.filter((a) => a !== 'show');

describe('modelsSpawnArgv — exactly two argv shapes (spec §2.7)', () => {
  it('show is [models, <lane>, show], frozen', () => {
    const argv = modelsSpawnArgv('lane-a', 'show');
    expect(argv).toEqual(['models', 'lane-a', 'show']);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(argv)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('each writing action takes each class: [models, <lane>, <action>, <class>], frozen', () => {
    expect(WRITING).toHaveLength(3);
    for (const action of WRITING) {
      for (const cls of CLASSES) {
        const argv = modelsSpawnArgv('lane-a', action, cls);
        expect(argv, `${action} ${cls}`).toEqual(['models', 'lane-a', action, cls]);
        expect(Object.isFrozen(argv)).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });

  it.each([
    ['the first reserved word as a lane', () => modelsSpawnArgv(MODELS_RESERVED_IDS[0]!, 'show')],
    ['the second reserved word as a lane', () => modelsSpawnArgv(MODELS_RESERVED_IDS[1]!, 'show')],
    ['a lane with a slash', () => modelsSpawnArgv('lane/a', 'show')],
    ['an action that is not one of the four', () => modelsSpawnArgv('lane-a', 'rm' as never)],
    ['a class on show', () => modelsSpawnArgv('lane-a', 'show', CLASSES[0])],
    ['no class on a writing action', () => modelsSpawnArgv('lane-a', 'hold')],
    ['a word that is not a class', () => modelsSpawnArgv('lane-a', 'hold', 'subagent')],
  ] as [string, () => unknown][])('throws RangeError for %s, so no argv exists', (_why, call) => {
    expect(call).toThrow(RangeError);
  });
});

describe("isModelsLaneId — the models writer's pattern, minus the reserved words", () => {
  it('takes a lane id', () => {

  });

  it.each([
    ['refresh'], ['litellm'], ['..'], ['../lane-a'], ['/'], ['lane/a'], ['-lane'], ['Lane-a'],
    [`a${'b'.repeat(32)}`], [''], ['lane a'], ['lane-a\n'], ['lane\u0000a'],
  ])('refuses %j', (bad) => {
    expect(isModelsLaneId(bad)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('refuses a value that is not a string', () => {
    for (const v of [null, undefined, 1, ['lane-a'], { id: 'lane-a' }]) expect(isModelsLaneId(v), String(v)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('reads the shared pattern and the shared reserved words: each reserved word passes the pattern alone', () => {
    expect(MODELS_RESERVED_IDS.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    for (const w of MODELS_RESERVED_IDS) {
      expect(MODELS_LANE_ID_RE.test(w), `${w} passes the pattern`).toBe(true);
      expect(isModelsLaneId(w), w).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

describe('the models op bounds (plan W4 §3.10)', () => {
  /** The lane-files lock's default wait, in seconds, from `ccd/ccrc`: every spelling of the default must agree. */
  const lockWaitS = (): number => {
    const waits = [...CCRC_TEXT.matchAll(/\$\{CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S:-(\d+)\}/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
    expect(waits.length, 'ccd/ccrc no longer spells the lane-files lock wait').toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(new Set(waits).size, 'two defaults for one wait').toBe(1);
    return waits[0]!;
  };

  it('are the plan values', () => {
    expect(MODELS_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS).toBe(40_000);
    expect(MODELS_KILL_GRACE_MS).toBe(2_000);
    expect(MODELS_DRAIN_MS).toBe(2_000);
    expect(MODELS_OP_TIMEOUT_MS).toBe(50_000);
    expect(MODELS_ANSWER_MAX_BYTES).toBe(262_144);
  });

  it('lock wait < spawn bound < spawn + grace + drain < op timeout', () => {
    expect(lockWaitS() * 1000).toBeLessThan(MODELS_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS);
    expect(MODELS_KILL_GRACE_MS).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(MODELS_DRAIN_MS).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(MODELS_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS + MODELS_KILL_GRACE_MS + MODELS_DRAIN_MS).toBeLessThan(MODELS_OP_TIMEOUT_MS);
  });
});

describe('the models op words (spec §2.7)', () => {
  it('the op word is its own, beside the other two', () => {
    expect(MODELS_OP).toBe('models');
    expect([UPDATE_OP, TOKEN_SYNC_OP]).not.toContain(MODELS_OP);
  });

  it('the error words are exactly the seven, closed, and isModelsOpError reads them and nothing else', () => {
    expect([...MODELS_OP_ERRORS]).toEqual(['bad-lane', 'bad-class', 'bad-action', 'busy', 'spawn-failed', 'timeout',
      'no-answer']);
    for (const w of MODELS_OP_ERRORS) expect(isModelsOpError(w), w).toBe(true);
    // `bad-request` stays the envelope's word for "this agent predates the op"; a verb's own refusal is never an op word.
    for (const w of ['bad-request', 'lock-busy', 'unknown-subcommand', 'BUSY', '', null, 1, undefined]) {
      expect(isModelsOpError(w), String(w)).toBe(false);
    }

  it('the actions are exactly four, each a `ccrc models` subcommand this build has, and isModelsAction reads them alone', () => {
    expect([...MODELS_ACTIONS]).toEqual(['show', 'hold', 'release', 'revert']);
    const subs = /^MODELS_SUBS="([^"]*)"$/m.exec(CCRC_TEXT);
    expect(subs, 'ccd/ccrc no longer spells MODELS_SUBS').not.toBeNull();
    for (const a of MODELS_ACTIONS) expect(subs![1]!.split(' '), a).toContain(a);
    for (const w of MODELS_ACTIONS) expect(isModelsAction(w), w).toBe(true);
    for (const w of ['show ', 'Hold', 'rm', 'set-class', '', null, 1]) expect(isModelsAction(w), String(w)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('the class guard is the imported CLASSES, and nothing else', () => {
    for (const c of CLASSES) expect(isModelsClass(c), c).toBe(true);
    for (const w of ['subagent', 'default', '', ` ${CLASSES[0]}`, CLASSES[0]!.toUpperCase(), null, 1]) {
      expect(isModelsClass(w), String(w)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it('a models frame is an AgentReq (the type half is checked by tsc, through typecheck-tests)', () => {
    const show: AgentReq = { t: 'req', id: 1, op: 'models', lane: 'lane-a', action: 'show' };
    const hold: AgentReq = { t: 'req', id: 2, op: 'models', lane: 'lane-a', action: 'hold', class: CLASSES[0] };
    expect([show.op, hold.op]).toEqual([MODELS_OP, MODELS_OP]);

});

describe("an older ccrc's usage line is the verb-missing line (D-5226)", () => {
  it('ccrc refuses a verb it lacks with `ccrc: unknown argument: <verb>` first on stderr, at exit 2', () => {
    const home = mkTmp('ccrc-models-verb-');
    const env = ghContainedEnv(home, { PATH: process.env.PATH ?? '', HOME: home, LANG: 'C' });
    const r = spawnSync('bash', [CCRC, 'models-nosuch'], { env, encoding: 'utf8', input: '' });
    expect(r.status).toBe(2);
    const first = (r.stderr ?? '').split('\n')[0]!;
    expect(first).toBe('ccrc: unknown argument: models-nosuch');
    // The same function prints the same line for a ccrc that has no `models` verb at all.
    expect(first.replace('models-nosuch', 'models')).toBe(MODELS_VERB_MISSING_LINE);
  });

  it('isModelsVerbMissing reads that exact line and nothing near it', () => {
    expect(isModelsVerbMissing(MODELS_VERB_MISSING_LINE)).toBe(true);
    for (const d of ['ccrc: unknown argument: models-x', 'ccrc: unknown argument: token', 'no message', '', null, undefined]) {
      expect(isModelsVerbMissing(d), String(d)).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts

// ── the `models` op (auto-advance spec 2026-10-13 §2.7, D14; plan W4) ────────────────────────────────────────────
// The THIRD wire-triggered spawn outside the exec whitelist, after `update` and `token-sync`: the agent spawns
// `<home>/.local/bin/ccrc models <lane> show`, or `… models <lane> <action> <class>`, and hands back the child's one
// JSON object. Everything both ends agree on is declared here once: the agent (`agent/src/modelsop.ts`,
// `agent/src/server.ts`) validates and spawns with it, and the server's link (`server/src/models/link.ts`) reads the
// answer with it. Bash cannot import this; the verbs the op spawns are `ccd/ccrc`'s own `MODELS_SUBS`, and
// `server/test/models-op-shared.test.ts` holds the four actions to that list.
//
// Answer: `ok` with `{exit: 0 | 1 | 2, answer: <the child's one JSON object>}` whenever the child printed exactly one
// object, a REFUSAL OF THE VERB included (`lock-busy`, `no-previous`, `unknown-subcommand`, …): the server reads it.
// A refusal OF THE OP is one of `MODELS_OP_ERRORS`, with `detail`.
//
// An import placed here rather than at the head of the file: this file is cited by line, and the import is
// hoisted either way (`shared/api.ts` does the same).
import { CLASSES, MODELS_LANE_ID_RE, MODELS_RESERVED_IDS, type ModelClass } from './models.js';

/** The op's name, and the word an agent that answers it lists in `ready.ops`. */
export const MODELS_OP = 'models';

/** The four actions. `show` reads (D14: the Models panel reads through this op, never through a widened file read);
 *  the other three are the D12 shell verbs, each taking one class. */
export const MODELS_ACTIONS = ['show', 'hold', 'release', 'revert'] as const;
export type ModelsAction = (typeof MODELS_ACTIONS)[number];
/** Use THIS, never `MODELS_ACTIONS.includes(x as ModelsAction)` — `isRunState`'s rule. */
export function isModelsAction(v: unknown): v is ModelsAction {
  return typeof v === 'string' && (MODELS_ACTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(v);
}

/** The op's class guard: one of `CLASSES`, imported and never spelled here. */
export function isModelsClass(v: unknown): v is ModelClass {
  return typeof v === 'string' && (CLASSES as readonly string[]).includes(v);
}

/** The ONLY words the agent's `models` case refuses with. `bad-request` is deliberately NOT a member: from this op it
 *  keeps meaning "this agent predates it". The three `bad-*` words are `validateReq`'s, answered before any spawn;
 *  `busy` is the gate's; `spawn-failed` (the launcher could not start), `timeout` (the child was stopped at the
 *  bound) and `no-answer` (its stdout was not exactly one JSON object, or passed the cap) are the spawn's. */
export const MODELS_OP_ERRORS = ['bad-lane', 'bad-class', 'bad-action', 'busy', 'spawn-failed', 'timeout', 'no-answer'] as const;
export type ModelsOpError = (typeof MODELS_OP_ERRORS)[number];
/** Use THIS, never `MODELS_OP_ERRORS.includes(x as ModelsOpError)`. */
export function isModelsOpError(v: unknown): v is ModelsOpError {
  return typeof v === 'string' && (MODELS_OP_ERRORS as readonly string[]).includes(v);
}

/** THE ONE lane guard (spec §2.7: "the id against the models writer's stricter id pattern"): the pattern
 *  `deploy/models-op.mjs` re-exports as `ACCOUNT_ID_RE`, and not one of the words `ccrc models` reads as a box-wide
 *  subcommand. So `..`, `/`, a leading `-`, an upper-case letter and a 33rd character are refused before any argv
 *  exists, and a reserved word can never reach the box-wide arm. */
export function isModelsLaneId(v: unknown): v is string {
  return typeof v === 'string' && MODELS_LANE_ID_RE.test(v) && !MODELS_RESERVED_IDS.includes(v);
}

/** THE TWO SHAPES (spec §2.7): `['models', lane, 'show']` or `['models', lane, action, cls]`, so the spawn is
 *  `ccrc models <lane> show` or `ccrc models <lane> hold|release|revert <class>`. Each guard runs AGAIN here, though
 *  the agent's `validateReq` ran it first, so an edit that lets an unvalidated argument through the shape gate still
 *  never reaches a spawn. Frozen: a caller cannot append a flag. */
export function modelsSpawnArgv(lane: string, action: ModelsAction, cls?: string): readonly string[] {
  if (!isModelsLaneId(lane)) {
    throw new RangeError('modelsSpawnArgv: the lane is not a models lane id — a caller bug; nothing was spawned');
  }
  if (!isModelsAction(action)) {
    throw new RangeError(`modelsSpawnArgv: the action must be one of ${MODELS_ACTIONS.join(', ')} (got ${JSON.stringify(action)})`);
  }
  if (action === 'show') {
    if (cls !== undefined) throw new RangeError('modelsSpawnArgv: show takes no class — a caller bug; nothing was spawned');
    return Object.freeze(['models', lane, 'show']);
  }
  if (!isModelsClass(cls)) {
    throw new RangeError(`modelsSpawnArgv: ${action} takes one of ${CLASSES.join(', ')} — a caller bug; nothing was spawned`);
  }
  return Object.freeze(['models', lane, action, cls]);
}

/** The agent's bound on the child: SIGTERM to its process group here, SIGKILL `MODELS_KILL_GRACE_MS` later. It sits
 *  above the lane-files lock's 20 s wait (`ccd/ccrc`'s `CCRC_MODELS_LOCK_S` default, which the child's three-name
 *  environment cannot override), so a verb that waits out a writer refuses `lock-busy` by itself and is never killed
 *  for a slow lock. Pinned by `server/test/models-op-shared.test.ts`. */
export const MODELS_SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 40_000;
/** Then SIGKILL, this long after the SIGTERM. */
export const MODELS_KILL_GRACE_MS = 2_000;
/** ONE drain deadline, armed by the child's exit or by the SIGKILL, whichever comes first, never restarted. */
export const MODELS_DRAIN_MS = 2_000;
/** The server's `FleetClient.request` deadline for this op (the client's default is 15 s). Pinned: SPAWN + GRACE +
 *  DRAIN < this, so the agent always answers before the server gives up on the op. */
export const MODELS_OP_TIMEOUT_MS = 50_000;
/** The child's stdout cap. A `describe` answer is a few KiB; past this the op answers `no-answer`, never a cut object. */
export const MODELS_ANSWER_MAX_BYTES = 262_144;

/** The first stderr line of a `ccrc` that has no `models` verb at all: `_ccrc_usage_die`'s line for the verb. The
 *  server reads a `no-answer` carrying exactly this line as `verb-missing`, a named hold, never a fault
 *  (D-5226; the token op's `TOKEN_VERB_MISSING_PREFIXES` is the same idea). */
export const MODELS_VERB_MISSING_LINE = 'ccrc: unknown argument: models';
/** Exact equality, not a prefix: `ccrc: unknown argument: models-x` is another verb. */
export function isModelsVerbMissing(detail: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return detail === MODELS_VERB_MISSING_LINE;
}

/** Spec §2.7: ONE member of the `req` envelope, in two shapes. `lane` passes `isModelsLaneId`, `action`
 *  `isModelsAction`, and `class` is absent for `show` and passes `isModelsClass` otherwise — all in the agent's
 *  `validateReq`, before any case body sees the frame. A failure answers `bad-lane`, `bad-action` or `bad-class`,
 *  never `bad-request`. */
export type ModelsReq =
  | { t: 'req'; id: number; op: 'models'; lane: string; action: 'show' }
  | { t: 'req'; id: number; op: 'models'; lane: string; action: Exclude<ModelsAction, 'show'>; class: ModelClass };
```

```ts
interface Res { t: 'res'; id: number; ok: boolean; err?: string; detail?: string; exit?: number; answer?: unknown }
interface SpawnCall { file: string; args: string[]; timeoutMs: number }

const WRITING = ['hold', 'release', 'revert'] as const;

/** A recording `spawnModels`. After `park()`, every call waits until `release()`. */
function recorder(answer: ModelsSpawnResult = ANSWERED) {
  const calls: SpawnCall[] = [];
  let gate: Promise<void> | null = null;
  let open: () => void = () => {};
  const spawn: ModelsSpawn = async (file, args, timeoutMs) => {
    calls.push({ file, args: [...args], timeoutMs });
    if (gate !== null) await gate;
    return answer;
  };
  return {
    calls,
    spawn,
    park(): void { gate = new Promise<void>((r) => { open = r; }); },
    release(): void { gate = null; open(); },
  };
}

/** The text between `open` and the first `close` match after it, from the real source. */
function slice(src: string, open: string, close: RegExp): string {
  const at = src.indexOf(open);
  expect(at, `${open} not found`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  const rest = src.slice(at + open.length);
  const end = close.exec(rest);
  expect(end, `no end after ${open}`).not.toBeNull();
  return rest.slice(0, end!.index);
}
```
